title: Demonstrate both Must flows end to end
statement: By 30 April 2027, the team shall demonstrate both Must task flows end to end with real testers: an obligation from message to completion with an evidence level, and a request to a business from message to a known outcome.
source_trace_up: RTR BR-01 (revised to the combined scope); CP §1, §6.1
acceptance_criterion: Demo script on the pilot channel completes both flows; evaluation logs show at least one completed flow of each type per tester who attempted it

title: 80% complete obligation flow unaided
statement: In the evaluation, at least 80% of testers shall complete capture → confirm → reminder without help from the team.
source_trace_up: RTR BR-02 (RTR's "≥ 60% in the first session" replaced by the CP E8 target and measure; decision D4); goal G1
acceptance_criterion: Point estimate ≥ 80% over all testers' logs (E8), with the Wilson interval reported

title: Reminder-only baseline comparison (deferred)
statement: *Deferred.* (RTR: the pilot shall compare the acting assistant with a reminder-only baseline on the same tasks.)
acceptance_criterion: N/A (Deferred)

title: 70% of requests reach known outcome
statement: In the evaluation, at least 70% of request tasks shall reach a known outcome (answered, declined, or clearly no reply).
acceptance_criterion: Point estimate ≥ 70% of request tasks in the logs (E8), interval reported

title: Show only observed states and evidence
statement: The prototype shall show a task to its user only in a state and evidence level that the system has observed.
acceptance_criterion: E6 audit of every evaluation task finds 0 tasks shown as sent, booked or done without the matching trigger or evidence

title: No action without a confirmation tap
statement: No action shall leave the system for a third party without a valid confirmation tap by the user.
acceptance_criterion: E3: every adapter tested with no tap, an old token, a reused token and an edited card; 0 actions leave

title: Report compares flows with Abdul
statement: The final report shall compare the prototype's flows with Abdul's advertised features, using public information only.
source_trace_up: CP E13; REC §6; TEAM-BRIEF research boundary
acceptance_criterion: The report contains the E13 table, states that recurrence parity is partial, and cites public sources only

title: Median message-to-Confirm within 2 minutes
statement: The median time from a tester's first message to a confirmed task shall be 2 minutes or less.
acceptance_criterion: Median of logged first-message-to-Confirm times ≤ 120 s

title: Report business answers by adapter
statement: The evaluation shall report, split by adapter, the outcomes of 15–25 real request cards: share answered, declined, no answer, time to answer, share that needed a phone call, team minutes per handled request (if S2 is built) and repeat use within 30 days.
source_trace_up: CP E11; VJ success metrics; judge D-12
acceptance_criterion: Report table with each measure per adapter and its interval; self-answered reply-page answers excluded

title: Design finalised by 22 Nov 2026
statement: The architecture and overall design shall be finalised and submitted with the proposal no later than Sunday 22 November 2026.
acceptance_criterion: A submission receipt dated on or before 22 Nov 2026 exists, and the G2 approval record is dated on or before 20 Nov 2026

title: Prototype and report by 30 Apr 2027
statement: The evaluated prototype and the final report shall be delivered no later than 30 April 2027.
acceptance_criterion: A G9 closure record and a final-submission receipt are dated on or before 30 Apr 2027

title: No features after freeze date
statement: No new feature work shall start after the feature-freeze date chosen in TD4 (14 Feb 2027 under option A, 14 Mar 2027 under option B), and after 11 April 2027 only defect fixes and closure work shall be done.
acceptance_criterion: The issue log shows no feature issue opened after the freeze date, except one recorded change request that removes equal work (charter §9); no feature commit after 11 Apr 2027

title: Must build effort within 160 hours
statement: The Must build-and-test effort (packages M1–M5) shall be estimated at no more than 160 person-hours at the high estimate, within the 120–160 person-hour ceiling.
acceptance_criterion: The bottom-up table in CP §6.2 shows M1–M5 at 80–113 h (midpoint 96.5 h), or 89–125 h with S0. Re-checked with actual hours at the end of P1

title: Must midpoint within scenario C capacity
statement: The midpoint estimate of the whole Must scope (M1–M7) shall not exceed the usable capacity of the planning scenario in force, which is scenario C at 3.5 h per person per week (141.75 h) until the real calendar is recorded at A11.
acceptance_criterion: CP Must 134 h plus the NEW Must rows of Appendix H (mid 4.125 h) = 138.125 h ≤ 141.75 h (margin 3.625 h) at the proposal (judge D-01). At each two-weekly forecast, remaining Must work ≤ remaining usable capacity; otherwise the cut order in CP §6.5 is applied and recorded

title: Count at most 4 hours per member-week
statement: Plans and forecasts shall count at most 4 hours per member per week, and shall count any extra hours only when the member has volunteered them and they are recorded in the forecast.
acceptance_criterion: Each forecast sheet shows hours per member ≤ 4 a week, or a dated note of volunteered extra hours

title: Running costs within approved monthly cap
statement: Total running costs during the pilot (LLM API, hosting and database, LINE Official Account plan) shall not exceed the monthly cap approved by the team at D05/D06 (16 Nov 2026).
source_trace_up: RTR CON-BUD-01; charter §10 budget table; AI-COST-01, AI-COST-02; criterion changed by judge D-01 (OPS-07 now Should)
acceptance_criterion: At G3 and G6, inspection shows the provider-side hard limit (AI-COST-03), the LINE plan (CON-BUD-02) and the hosting plan are set at or below the approved cap; where monthly cost reports (OPS-07, Should) exist, actual spend ≤ the cap

title: LINE plan covers forecast pushes
statement: During the evaluation window, the LINE Official Account shall be on a plan whose monthly message allowance is at least the forecast number of push messages for that month.
acceptance_criterion: Before G6, an analysis shows forecast pushes ≤ plan allowance (TD5 option A: Basic plan; option B: Free plan with a cap of 15 pushes per tester for 20 testers). During the pilot, OPS-06 alerts confirm the allowance was never reached

title: LINE Official Account is the only channel
statement: The only user channel shall be a LINE Official Account using the Messaging API; there shall be no separate mobile app.
acceptance_criterion: Every Must user flow in the demo script starts in the OA chat; no app-store build exists

title: Handoff always offers copy-and-send fallback
statement: Any flow that uses the LINE oaMessage handoff shall also offer the copy-and-send fallback, because the handoff works only in the LINE mobile app and not in LINE for PC.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
source_trace_up: CP §4.4 [V, LINE URL scheme docs and judge spot-check, 9 Nov 2026]
acceptance_criterion: Design inspection of the router shows both adapters on every request path; one test on LINE for PC shows the fallback

title: No bot posting into business or group chats
statement: The design shall not depend on our bot posting into a business's chat, into a LINE group, or through the user's own account.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: every outbound path to a business is a user-tap handoff, the copy fallback, or (S2) a human operator

title: One app, one worker, Postgres, one LLM
statement: The system shall be built from one web application, one worker process, one PostgreSQL database and one hosted LLM API, using the stack and providers chosen at D05 and D06 (16 Nov 2026).
acceptance_criterion: The deployment configuration at G3 lists only these four runtime parts plus LINE

title: LLM provider with no-training terms
statement: The LLM provider chosen at D06 shall offer API terms under which our prompts and outputs are not used for training and are retained for no longer than abuse monitoring requires (zero retention where offered).
acceptance_criterion: The D06 decision record quotes the provider's current terms with an access date and the retention period they state

title: No real personal data in repository
statement: The repository shall contain no real personal data; test data shall be synthetic or tester-consented and, if consented, stored outside the repository.
acceptance_criterion: At each gate, a search of the repository for phone numbers, LINE user IDs and real names finds none; the review is recorded

title: Abdul study uses public information only
statement: Any study of Abdul shall use only public information and ordinary, hand-typed use of advertised features, within the TEAM-BRIEF research boundary.
source_trace_up: TEAM-BRIEF "Abdul research boundary"; Abdul terms (forbid reverse-engineering, scraping, probing)
acceptance_criterion: The black-box run notes show hand use only, at most about 10 messages per 10 minutes, no automation, no prompt-injection text, and the T39–T40 clean-up done

title: Advisor approves proposal and final acceptance
statement: The proposal and the final acceptance shall be approved by the authority the course names (advisor or committee), at G2 and G8.
acceptance_criterion: Signed or emailed approval records for G2 and G8 exist. The course's approval rules are UNVERIFIED (OI-19)

title: Businesses answer request cards without sign-up
statement: Businesses will answer a request card, in their own chat or (S0) on the reply page, without signing up.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: STK-03, BR-09, FR-RP-01…FR-RP-07, E11
acceptance_criterion: Check: E11 field result; 3–5 friendly shops asked in P3. PD, by G7

title: Share-target picker not relied upon
statement: The LINE share-target picker cannot be relied on to deliver a card to a business's OA chat. The design does not depend on it.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: C4 adapter only
acceptance_criterion: Check: P1 spike on testers' phones. TL, by G3 (13 Dec 2026)

title: Apps may fetch links for previews
statement: LINE and other apps may fetch a URL posted in a chat to build a link preview, so a GET on the reply page can happen without a person.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: QR-SE-01, FR-HND-03, IF-RP-01, E6
acceptance_criterion: Check: Link-preview test: post the reply-page link into a test LINE chat and check that no state changes. TL, before S0 is released
evidence: UNVERIFIED for LINE in this case; rule is cheap either way

title: oaMessage opens shop chat with text
statement: The oaMessage URL opens the shop's chat with our pre-filled Thai text on testers' phones; the user can edit the text before sending; we cannot see whether it was sent.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: IF-OAM-01, FR-HND-01…FR-HND-03, QR-CO-01
acceptance_criterion: Check: P1 spike on at least one iOS and one Android phone. TL, by G3
evidence: Behaviour [V, LINE URL scheme docs]; on testers' devices UNVERIFIED

title: Two exam fortnights at half capacity
statement: The university calendar has two two-week exam periods inside 23 Nov 2026–25 Apr 2027, worked at half capacity (scenario C).
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: CON-TEAM-02, phase plan
acceptance_criterion: Check: Record the real academic calendar (action A11). PD, by 13 Nov 2026

title: Ethics approval obtainable before G6
statement: The university's human-participant approval can be obtained during P2 and before G6 (28 Feb 2027; review Fri 26 Feb), and covers businesses as third-party data subjects.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: LEG-04, M6, VER-03
acceptance_criterion: Check: Ask the advisor (action A12). PS, by 13 Nov 2026

title: Members sustain 3-4 hours a week
statement: Each member sustains 3–4 h a week, and a 25% allowance covers coordination and availability changes.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: CON-TEAM-02
acceptance_criterion: Check: Two-weekly forecast; actual hours per line compared at the end of P1. PD

title: 15-20 eligible testers recruitable
statement: 15–20 testers aged 20 or over (or married) can be recruited from staff, later-year and graduate students by 28 Feb 2027.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: VER-03, E8–E10
acceptance_criterion: Check: Recruitment count at G6. Evaluation lead

title: 3-5 friendly shops agree in advance
statement: 3–5 friendly shops near campus with a known LINE ID agree in advance to receive request cards.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: E11, TR-07
acceptance_criterion: Check: Signed or recorded agreement in P3. Evaluation lead

title: About one push per tester per day
statement: Testers average about one push message a day.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: CON-BUD-02, OPS-06
acceptance_criterion: Check: Push counter during P5 (E5)

title: Testers use LINE on a smartphone
statement: Testers use LINE on a smartphone for the request flow.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: CON-PLAT-02
acceptance_criterion: Check: Screening question at onboarding (TR-02)

title: No working code needed at proposal
statement: The course does not require a working implementation at the proposal stage.
source_trace_up: Requirements that depend on it: DOC-01
acceptance_criterion: Check: Obtain the rubric (OI-19). PD, by 13 Nov 2026

title: LINE Messaging API behaves as documented
statement: LINE Messaging API behaviour as documented on 9 Nov 2026: signed webhooks, at-least-once delivery, push with X-Line-Retry-Key [V, LINE docs via CP §14]
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: None for the channel; contract tests (VER-07) detect changes

title: LINE pricing model stays stable
statement: LINE keeps its Messaging API pricing model through April 2027. Reply API charges above 25,000 replies a month from 1 Feb 2027 [V, LINE Thailand notice, 30 Oct 2026] are far above our volume [I]
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Re-cost under CON-BUD-01

title: LLM provider meeting CON-TECH-02
statement: An LLM provider that meets CON-TECH-02, chosen at D06 (16 Nov 2026)
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Structured question flow without AI (FR-CAP-04, AI-BEH-03); reminders keep working

title: Hosting and Postgres provider with backups
statement: A hosting and PostgreSQL provider chosen at D05 (16 Nov 2026), with daily backups available
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Self-managed database dump to storage (OPS-02)

title: University human-participant approval
statement: University human-participant approval (LEG-04)
source_trace_up: Needed by: G6, 28 Feb 2027 (review Fri 26 Feb)
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Synthetic sessions only; report the reduced evidence

title: Advisor approval at G2 and G8
statement: Advisor or committee approval at G2 and G8 (CON-ACAD-03)
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Escalate early; record the decision

title: Funding for LINE Basic plan
statement: Funding for the LINE Basic plan for the evaluation months (TD5 option A, about ฿2,740 for two months [I])
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: TD5 option B (Free plan, 15 pushes per tester)

title: Team decisions TD1-TD6, D05, D06, D08
statement: Team decisions TD1–TD6 by 13 Nov 2026; D05, D06 by 16 Nov; D08 by 18 Nov
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: The recommendations in CP §13 are used as defaults and recorded

title: Legal advice on s.28 and CCA s.26
statement: Advice from the advisor or the university legal office on the PDPA s.28 transfer basis and on Computer-Related Crime Act s.26
acceptance_criterion: Fallback if it fails: Keep minimal traffic metadata separable so either answer can be applied (OI-14)

title: No voice calls, SMS, email or payments
statement: AI voice phone calls, SMS and email sending; holding or moving money (payments, subscriptions, wallets)
source_trace_up: Legal review, cost and licensing (LEG-03); no evidence of demand yet
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No direct booking or partner APIs
statement: Level 3 direct booking, partner APIs, browser agents for web forms, merchant dashboard
source_trace_up: Needs offer binding, reconciliation and legal review (CP §4.1)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No bot inside LINE groups
statement: The bot inside LINE groups: group polls, group reminders, group summaries
source_trace_up: One OA per group (CON-PLAT-03); data rules for group members
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No Google Calendar or Gmail OAuth
statement: Google Calendar or Gmail OAuth
source_trace_up: Google verification effort; .ics file (C3) covers the need
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No Google Places or Wongnai recommendations
statement: Venue recommendations from Google Places or Wongnai data
source_trace_up: Maps ToS s.3.2.3 and Wongnai terms [V, via CP §10]; LEG-10
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No escalation, holy-day recurrence or voice
statement: Escalation-until-acknowledged reminders, วันพระ recurrence, voice-note input
source_trace_up: Hours; Abdul parity is stated as partial in E13
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No medical requests or under-20 testers
statement: Medical requests and testers under 20 (unless married)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No login or sign-up on reply page
statement: LINE Login, LIFF or any sign-up on the business-facing reply page
source_trace_up: STK-03 (no sign-up); the page never collects the business person's LINE ID (CP §7.5)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: No workflow engine or 24/7 support
statement: Temporal or other workflow engines; 24/7 support; service-level promises
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: not built; listed as future work

title: One message becomes a tracked task
statement: A tester shall be able to turn one chat message into a confirmed, tracked task without retyping information the message already contains.
acceptance_criterion: In moderated sessions, each tester confirms a task from one message; no field present in the message is re-asked unless flagged low-confidence (AI-HAL-02)

title: See and edit content before it leaves
statement: A tester shall be able to see the exact content of anything sent on their behalf, and edit or cancel it, before it leaves the system.
acceptance_criterion: Every outbound path shows the exact text with Confirm, Edit, Cancel (inspection of all card templates; E3 tests)

title: Business answers with one tap, no account
statement: A business shall be able to answer a request card with one tap, without creating an account.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: On the reply page, one Accept, Decline or Stop tap plus its confirm tap records an answer; no login or form

title: Business can stop further requests
statement: A business shall be able to stop further requests from the system.
acceptance_criterion: Every card text tells the business how to stop; a recorded stop blocks new cards to that venue (FR-RTE-04)

title: Business told an AI prepared the card
statement: A business receiving a card shall be told that an AI assistant prepared it for a named user.
acceptance_criterion: Every card template contains the disclosure line and the nickname (inspection)

title: Tester sees prepared, sent, answered, evidence
statement: A tester shall be able to tell, for every task, whether a request was only prepared, sent or answered, and whether a done task has evidence.
acceptance_criterion: Each state in Table 3.2.9-A has a distinct user label; E6 audit

title: Tester controls reminder timing
statement: A tester shall be able to control when reminders reach them (quiet hours and snooze).
source_trace_up: CP anti-goal "reminders become stress"; OMM §5; REC P-4
acceptance_criterion: Quiet hours and snooze work as in FR-REM-02, FR-REM-03

title: Invited person sees one shared item only
statement: An invited person shall be able to see one shared item and mark it done, with no access to anything else of the owner's.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: E7 isolation tests pass for granted and revoked shares

title: Operator records phone outcomes, logged
statement: An operator shall be able to see requests that need a phone call and record each outcome, with every step logged and timed.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Console lists such requests; each recorded outcome has operator, timestamps and minutes

title: Supervisor traces Must rows to tests
statement: The supervisor shall be able to trace every Must requirement to an acceptance criterion and, before the Phase 1 gate (G3, end of P1: 13 Dec 2026, review Fri 11 Dec 2026), to a test or evaluation case.
acceptance_criterion: Traceability filter shows no Must row without an acceptance criterion (v0.9) and test link (G3)

title: Tester gets copy or deletion of data
statement: A tester shall be able to obtain a copy of, or the deletion of, their data.
acceptance_criterion: Export and delete commands work as in FR-DATA-01, FR-DATA-02

title: Bill message becomes filled card
statement: As a tester, I want to type "ค่าไฟ 1,245 บาท จ่ายภายใน 25 พ.ย." and get a card with the amount and date filled in, so that I do not retype them.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given that message, when I send it, then a confirmation card shows ฿1,245, due 25 Nov 2026 (BE and CE), with Confirm, Edit, Cancel

title: Fix one wrong field by tapping
statement: As a tester, I want to fix one wrong field by tapping, so that a mistake does not mean starting again.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given a card with a wrong date, when I tap Edit → Date and pick a new one, then a new card version shows it and the old Confirm no longer works

title: Reminder at chosen time, respects quiet hours
statement: As a tester, I want a reminder at the time I chose, with Done and Snooze, and no follow-ups or other system messages during my quiet hours.
acceptance_criterion: Given quiet hours 22:00–07:00: a reminder I set for 23:00 arrives at 23:00 with Done and Snooze buttons; a follow-up the system scheduled for 23:30 arrives at 07:00

title: Mark bill done and attach slip
statement: As a tester, I want to mark a bill done and attach the slip, so that I can later see it was really handled.
acceptance_criterion: Given a reminder, when I tap Done and send a slip image, then the task shows "Done (slip attached)"

title: Prepared haircut request opens shop chat
statement: As a tester, I want the assistant to prepare my haircut request and open the shop's chat with the text ready, so that sending it takes one tap.
acceptance_criterion: Given a verified venue with a LINE ID, when I confirm the card, then I get a button that opens that shop's chat with the exact confirmed text

title: Report sent and answer, get reminder
statement: As a tester, I want to tell the assistant whether I sent the request and what the shop answered, so that it reminds me of the agreed time.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given I tapped "Yes, sent" and later "Accepted, Sat 14:00", then the task is Scheduled with a reminder before 14:00

title: Bill split with PromptPay QR codes
statement: As a student who paid for a group dinner, I want each friend to get a PromptPay QR code to my own account, so that I am repaid without chasing people.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Given 4 participants and ฿1,000 equal split, each QR encodes ฿250 and my PromptPay ID; I confirm before anything is shown to others

title: Withdraw a mistaken request within 10 minutes
statement: As a tester, I want to withdraw a request I sent by mistake within 10 minutes, and be told what I must undo myself.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given a request sent 5 minutes ago and unanswered, when I tap Withdraw, then it shows Withdrawn and tells me to unsend the chat message myself

title: Reach phone-only shop by copy or call
statement: As a tester, I want to request a shop that has no LINE ID by copying a ready message or calling, so that phone-only shops are still reachable.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given a venue with only a phone number, when I confirm, then I get the text as a separate bubble, a call button, and the "Did you send it?" question

title: Request data export or deletion by command
statement: As a tester, I want to ask for my data or its deletion by typing a command, so that I keep control of it.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Given I type "delete my data" and confirm, then I am told the deletion will be done within 30 days and the request is logged for the team

title: Shop accepts a time with one tap
statement: As a shop owner, I want to accept one of the offered times with one tap, without signing up.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Given an open card link, when I tap "14:00 OK" and confirm, then the requester is told within one minute (job-run time)

title: Monthly rent repeats each month
statement: As a tester, I want my monthly rent to repeat on the same day each month.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Given rent due on the 31st monthly, then February's occurrence falls on the last day of February

title: List items due in next N days
statement: As a tester, I want a list of what is due in the next N days, optionally before my payday.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Given 3 items due within 7 days, when I ask "upcoming", then all 3 are listed by due date

title: Share one bill with a partner
statement: As a tester, I want to share one bill with my partner, so that either of us can mark it paid.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Given an accepted share, my partner sees only that item and can mark it done; after I revoke, they see nothing

title: Operator list of requests needing a call
statement: As an operator, I want a list of requests that need a call, so that I can phone the shop and record the outcome.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Given a phone-only venue in a staffed window, the request appears in the console and my recorded outcome reaches the tester

title: Create calendar event (reserved, deferred)
statement: Create calendar event from chat (reserved). *Deferred.* RTR used this number for a Google Calendar flow, which is Won't (OOS-04). Kept so the number is never reused
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: Business answers on reply page
statement: Business answers on the reply page. Business opens the link from the card (GET shows the card only). Taps an offered time, Decline or Stop, then confirms (POST). First valid, non-self answer: Answered via reply page (counts as sent); requester notified; accepted → Scheduled with reminder. Alternatives: expired or withdrawn card shows only a status line; second answer shows "already answered"; self-answer flagged, no state change (FR-RP-01…07)
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: Create a recurring obligation
statement: Create a recurring obligation. Tester says "ค่าเช่า 5,000 ทุกวันที่ 1". Card shows the rule and the next 3 dates; Confirm stores the rule apart from occurrences. Each occurrence has its own reminder and Done (FR-REC-01…03)
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: See what is due soon
statement: See what is due soon. Tester types "upcoming" (optionally "before payday 25"). System replies with open items due in N days, sorted, with a count and total amount (FR-UPC-01, 02)
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: Share one item
statement: Share one item. Owner taps Share on a task and sends the invite link to one person. Invitee accepts (notice and age statement). Both see status; either can mark done. Owner revokes: access ends at once (FR-SHR-01…04)
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: Operator handles phone-only request
statement: Operator handles a phone-only request. Router picks the operator adapter inside a published window. Operator sees the request in the console, phones the shop, records the outcome; tester is told; every step logged and timed (FR-OPC-01…03)
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3)

title: Reject webhooks with bad signatures
statement: The system shall reject any webhook request whose x-line-signature does not match the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body computed with the channel secret.
acceptance_criterion: Forged, missing and body-altered signatures are rejected with no event stored (CP §9.2, test of ≥ 3 cases)

title: Answer user events with reply API
statement: The system shall answer each user-initiated event with the reply API while its reply token is valid.
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection of every send path; pilot log shows no push sent in answer to a user event whose reply token was unused and unexpired

title: Push only for listed message types
statement: The system shall use push messages only for reminders, follow-ups, expiry notices, nudges and digests (QR-RE-04), the end-of-pilot closing message (TR-05) and asynchronous results.
source_trace_up: Judge D-08 (second clause of IF-LINE-02); RTR IF-LINE-02; REC P-11
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection: every push call site is one of the listed types; the push counter (OPS-06) labels each push with its type

title: Return 200 after storing, before LLM
statement: The system shall return HTTP 200 for a correctly signed webhook request after storing its events in the inbox and before calling the LLM.
acceptance_criterion: Test with a stubbed slow LLM: 200 is returned before the LLM call starts

title: Deduplicate events on webhookEventId
statement: The system shall store each webhookEventId under a unique constraint, in the same transaction as the work the event creates, and shall ignore an event whose ID is already stored.
source_trace_up: SEED (IF-LINE-01, QR-RE-01 row of CP §5); OMM §8.1
acceptance_criterion: Replay of ≥ 100 events, including redeliveries and out-of-order events, creates 0 duplicates (CP §9.2, E5)

title: Push with retry key; 409 means sent
statement: The system shall send every push with an X-Line-Retry-Key unique to that message occurrence and recipient, shall retry only on HTTP 500 or timeout with the same key, and shall treat HTTP 409 as sent.
acceptance_criterion: Fault test: timeout then retry gives one delivered push and the occurrence marked sent on 409

title: Per-tester monthly push cap
statement: The system shall count pushes per recipient per calendar month and, when a recipient reaches the per-tester cap, shall send that recipient no further push except reminders until the month ends.
conditional: Must if TD5 = B, Free plan
source_trace_up: REC P-11; CP TD5, E5; demoted M → S by judge D-01 (TD5 recommendation A, Basic plan, needs no cap), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Test with the cap set to 3: a 4th follow-up is not sent, a reminder is; monthly counts match LINE's "messages sent this month" figure within 2% (same rule as OPS-06). Cap value: set at TD5 (13 Nov 2026); proposal 40 on Basic, 15 on Free

title: Pause pushes after unfollow
statement: When the system receives an unfollow event, it shall pause all scheduled pushes to that user until a follow event arrives.
acceptance_criterion: Test: after unfollow, due jobs are paused, not sent; after follow, they resume

title: Leave groups; store no group content
statement: When the bot is added to a group or multi-person chat, the system shall leave it and store no message content from it.
source_trace_up: CP §10 ("no bot in groups"); DR-07; REC P-6 (Won't)
acceptance_criterion: Test: a join event causes a leave call; inbox holds no group message content

title: Flex alternative text (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into A11Y-02 (Appendix F). Original text: Every Flex message the system sends shall carry plain-text alternative text that names the action and its main values.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all Flex templates

title: Single LLM adapter with schema and timeout
statement: The system shall call the LLM provider through a single adapter that requests schema-constrained JSON output and stops waiting after a timeout, after which the structured question flow runs.
acceptance_criterion: Test with stubbed timeout and invalid JSON: user gets the first structured question; no task is created from the bad output. Timeout value TBD after spike (13 Dec 2026)

title: No identifiers sent to LLM (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into PRV-11 (Appendix F). Original text: The system shall send the LLM provider no LINE user ID, display name, nickname or secret, and only the message text and context needed for the current extraction.
source_trace_up: OMM §8.5 (minimum context); PRV-02, PRV-05; REC P-10
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the adapter and a logged-payload test on 20 sample requests: 0 identifiers found

title: Build oaMessage handoff link
statement: The system shall build each handoff link as https://line.me/R/oaMessage/{LINE ID}/?{text} with the confirmed card text UTF-8 percent-encoded.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Spike on testers' phones (iOS and Android) opens the right chat with the exact Thai text for 10 test cards. Maximum text length TBD after spike (13 Dec 2026)

title: Handoff LINE ID only from confirmed card
statement: The LINE ID in a handoff link shall be one shown on the card the user confirmed, taken from the venue table or typed by the user, never from model output alone.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Injection test items (E4) that name another LINE ID cause 0 links to an unconfirmed ID

title: Handoff says mobile only, offers copy
statement: The handoff message shall state that the link works in LINE on a phone only and shall offer the copy-and-send text alongside it.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the handoff template; demo on LINE for PC shows the copy path works

title: Reply page answers only by POST
statement: The reply page shall accept an answer only as an HTTP POST that carries the card token and the chosen answer.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: GET with any parameters records no answer; POST with a valid token does

title: No login or LIFF on reply page
statement: The reply page shall require no LINE Login, no LIFF, no account and no LINE ID from the business.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the page and its requests; no LINE SDK loaded

title: LIFF identity from verified ID token
statement: The server shall identify a LIFF user only from an ID token verified with LINE's verify endpoint.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test with a forged and an expired token: both rejected

title: Booking as .ics download
statement: The system shall provide a confirmed booking as an RFC 5545 .ics file, with the time in Asia/Bangkok, through a download link.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: The file imports with the right time into two calendar apps (TBD after spike)

title: PromptPay QR to Thai QR standard
statement: The system shall generate PromptPay QR payloads to the Bank of Thailand Thai QR standard, encoding the payer's own PromptPay ID and the amount.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Codes scan with the right payee and amount in at least two Thai bank apps (chosen if C2 is started)

title: Welcome with AI disclosure and notice
statement: On a follow event, the system shall reply with a welcome message that states it is an AI assistant and links to the privacy notice.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: follow event → welcome contains the disclosure line and notice link

title: No processing before notice accepted
statement: The system shall not store message content from, or send to the LLM any message of, a user who has not accepted the current privacy notice.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: a task message before acceptance creates no task, no LLM call, no stored text

title: Record age statement; block if No
statement: The system shall record the user's age statement (20 or over, or married) and shall process no task for a user who answered No.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: No → later messages create no task; Yes → recorded with time and notice version

title: Draft obligation from Thai or English text
statement: The system shall create a draft obligation from a Thai, English or mixed-language 1:1 text message, keeping the original message text with the draft.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test on the 50+ obligation items in the evaluation set: each yields a draft with source text stored. Accuracy itself is AI-EVAL-02 / E1

title: Ask type when classification unclear
statement: When the classification of a message is "unclear", the system shall ask the user to choose between obligation, request and neither by quick reply.
acceptance_criterion: Test with the 20 ambiguous items (E2): each unclear item gets the question

title: Convert dates to Asia/Bangkok instants
statement: The system shall convert every extracted date and time to an instant in Asia/Bangkok, accepting Buddhist-era and Common-era years and Thai relative dates.
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests: "25 พ.ย. 2569", "25 Nov 2026", "ศุกร์หน้า", "บ่ายสาม", "2 ทุ่ม" resolve to the expected instants for a fixed reference time; ambiguous ones are asked (AI-HAL-02)

title: Structured question flow when LLM fails
statement: When the LLM call fails, times out or returns output that fails schema validation, the system shall collect the task through a structured question flow (type, then each required field by quick reply or typed value).
acceptance_criterion: Test with stubbed failures: flow completes a valid task with no LLM call

title: Title and due date required
statement: The system shall require a title and a due date for an obligation, and shall treat amount and payee as optional fields.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: a message with no date leads to a date question; a message with no amount does not

title: Confirmation card shows values and buttons
statement: The confirmation card shall list the action type, recipient, date and time, amount (if any) and service, and shall offer Confirm, Edit and Cancel buttons.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of every card template; test that values come from the validated schema, not model free text

title: Each card version has token and hash
statement: The system shall give every card version its own version number, content hash and approval token, and shall invalidate the tokens of all earlier versions when a new version is created.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: Confirm on version 1 after an edit to version 2 is rejected

title: Confirm acts only on valid token
statement: On a Confirm postback, the system shall act only if the token matches the LINE user, task and current version, has not expired and has not been used, and shall then mark it used.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: E3: no tap, old token, reused token, other user's token, expired token → 0 actions; each case answered with the current card

title: Edit one field at a time
statement: The Edit button shall let the user change one field at a time by quick reply or typed value.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: UX-01; CP §6.2 (LIFF edit moved to C5)
acceptance_criterion: Test: each field of each card type can be changed in ≤ 3 taps plus an optional typed value

title: Cancel discards task, no job
statement: The Cancel button shall set the task to Discarded and create no job.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: after Cancel, no job rows and state Discarded

title: Approval token expires
statement: An approval token shall expire a fixed time after its card is shown.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test at expiry + 1 s: Confirm rejected. Duration TBD at freeze (20 Nov 2026); proposal 60 minutes. SEC-04 uses the same value

title: Cancel a tracked obligation
statement: The "Tracked" message of an obligation shall carry a Cancel task button that sets the task to Discarded after a confirming tap.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: Judge D-16 (closes OI-28); CP M2 line "capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel"; FR-REM-04
acceptance_criterion: Test: Cancel task then confirm → Discarded and pending reminder jobs cancelled (FR-REM-04); Cancel task without the confirming tap changes nothing

title: Reminders never early, 99% within 60 s
statement: The system shall submit no reminder push to LINE before its stored time, and at least 99% of reminder pushes within 60 seconds after it.
source_trace_up: RTR FR-REM-01; REC P-4; CP E5; judge D-07
acceptance_criterion: E5: of 1,000 scheduled test jobs, 0 are submitted before their stored time and ≥ 99% have their push call accepted by LINE (or the stub) within 60 s after it. ("Sent" means accepted by LINE; LINE does not confirm delivery)

title: Apply quiet-hours rule to system pushes
statement: The notifier shall apply the quiet-hours rule of QR-RE-04 to every system-scheduled push (follow-up, expiry notice, nudge, digest, repeat after snooze).
acceptance_criterion: Test with quiet hours 22:00–07:00: a follow-up due at 23:30 is sent at 07:00 ± 60 s; a user-set 23:00 reminder is sent at 23:00 ± 60 s. Default quiet hours TBD at freeze (20 Nov 2026); proposal 22:00–07:00

title: Snooze reschedules reminder
statement: The Snooze button shall reschedule the reminder to the option the user picks.
acceptance_criterion: Test each option. Options TBD at freeze; proposal 1 hour, 3 hours, tomorrow 09:00

title: Cancel jobs when task finishes
statement: When a task becomes Done, Withdrawn, Discarded, Closed or Expired, the system shall cancel its pending reminder and follow-up jobs.
acceptance_criterion: Test: Done before the reminder time → no push at that time

title: Reminders never call the LLM
statement: The system shall send scheduled reminders without calling the LLM provider.
acceptance_criterion: Test with the LLM endpoint blocked: scheduled reminders are sent

title: Default reminder time on card
statement: The confirmation card for an obligation shall show a default reminder time that the user can edit.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection and test. Default TBD at freeze; proposal 09:00 the day before the due date

title: Done sets user-reported evidence
statement: When the user taps Done on a Scheduled task, the system shall set the task to Done with evidence level user-reported.
acceptance_criterion: Test: Done → state and level stored; label "Done (you said so)"

title: Attach image only to chosen task
statement: The system shall attach an image to a task as evidence only when the user sent it after tapping that task's Attach button, or after choosing that task in answer to "Which task is this for?".
acceptance_criterion: Test: image after Attach → attached; image with no pending attach → the question, listing up to 5 open tasks. Attach window TBD at freeze; proposal 10 minutes

title: Later evidence upgrades Done state
statement: When evidence is attached to a task that is Done with level user-reported, the system shall change it to Done, evidence attached.
acceptance_criterion: Test of the transition and the new label

title: Keep evidence level after image deletion
statement: When retention deletes an evidence image, the system shall keep the task's evidence level and show it as "slip was attached (deleted per retention)".
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Time-shifted test: after the retention job, the image is gone and level and label are as stated

title: Slip labelled attached, never paid
statement: The system shall label an attached slip as "slip attached" and never as paid, verified or settled.
source_trace_up: OMM §5 ("no assumption that an image proves payment"); BR-05
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all labels and templates

title: Compose request card with five parts
statement: The system shall compose a request card containing the service, the time options, the user's nickname, the AI-disclosure line and a line telling the business how to stop further requests.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the template; test that every composed card has all five parts

title: Nickname on cards, never LINE ID
statement: The system shall show the user's chosen nickname on cards and never the LINE user ID or LINE display name.
acceptance_criterion: Test: a user with no nickname is asked for one before the first card; card text contains no LINE ID

title: One to three time options
statement: The system shall put one to three time options on a card, and shall ask for a second option when the user gave only one, accepting "no other time".
acceptance_criterion: Test: 1 option → question; "no other time" → card with 1 option; 4 options → user asked to choose 3

title: Refuse medical request cards (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into AI-SAFE-03 (Appendix F). Original text: The system shall refuse to compose a request card for a medical or health service and shall tell the user it is not supported.
acceptance_criterion: Test with ≥ 10 health-request items in the evaluation set: 0 cards composed

title: Router picks adapter from venue table
statement: The router shall choose the adapter for a confirmed card from the venue table: LINE handoff when a verified LINE ID exists, otherwise copy-and-send (operator in S2 windows; reply link added when S0 is built).
acceptance_criterion: Table-driven test over venue records with ID, phone only, neither

title: Venue table holds hand-checked facts only
statement: The venue table shall hold only facts the team checked by hand from the shop's own sign, page or OA profile (name, LINE ID or phone, opening hours, channel, confidence, last-verified date) and at most a Google place ID.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the table and its source column for all 10–15 venues

title: Record every channel attempt
statement: The system shall record every channel attempt (card, venue, adapter, handoff-opened time, sent-confirmed time, outcome, time to answer).
acceptance_criterion: Test: each outcome type writes exactly one attempt row with all listed fields

title: Update venue confidence score
statement: The system shall update the venue's confidence score from each recorded attempt outcome.
source_trace_up: Judge D-08 (second clause of FR-RTE-03); CP §4.4 ("each attempt updates the score"); E12
acceptance_criterion: Test: each outcome type moves the score in the expected direction. Score formula TBD at freeze (20 Nov 2026)

title: Stop marks venue do-not-contact
statement: When a business asks to stop (reported by the user, or S0 Stop), the system shall mark the venue do-not-contact and refuse new cards to it from any user.
acceptance_criterion: Test: after a stop, a new request to that venue is refused with a suggestion

title: Handoff button sets Handoff opened
statement: After a confirmed card is routed to the LINE handoff adapter, the system shall reply with a button that opens the handoff link and shall set the task to Handoff opened when LINE accepts that reply (decision D8).
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: state is Handoff opened after the reply is accepted; no "sent" label

title: Ask "Did you send it?" in same reply
statement: In the same reply as the handoff or copy-and-send message, the system shall ask "Did you send it?" with the postback buttons Yes, sent / Not yet / Not sending.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: one reply call (≤ 5 objects) carries both; no push used

title: Request sent only on Yes or POST
statement: The system shall treat a request as sent only when the user taps "Yes, sent" (state Request sent) or when the first valid, non-self POST answer arrives from the reply page (S0; state Answered via reply page, which counts as sent for E6).
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
source_trace_up: SEED-FR-05; fix 1; BR-05; E6; judge D-02
acceptance_criterion: E6 audit: 0 tasks in Request sent without one of the two triggers; test of both triggers and of a GET, a link preview and a self-answer (none changes state)

title: Copy-and-send for venues without LINE ID
statement: For a venue with no verified LINE ID, the system shall show the confirmed card text as its own message for copying, a call button when a phone number is known, and the "Did you send it?" question.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test with a phone-only and a no-contact venue

title: Not sending discards task
statement: When the user taps "Not sending", the system shall set the task to Discarded.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of the transition; follow-up jobs cancelled (FR-REM-04)

title: Follow-up asks whether shop answered
statement: When a request is in Request sent with no answer recorded at its follow-up time, the system shall push "Did the shop answer?" with Accepted / Other time / Declined / No reply yet / Shop asked to stop, at a time inside the venue's opening hours and outside the user's quiet hours.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test with venue hours and quiet hours fixtures. Follow-up delay TBD after spike (13 Dec 2026); proposal 3 opening hours after Request sent

title: Accepted answer schedules outcome reminder
statement: When the user reports Accepted and confirms the agreed time, the system shall set the task to User-confirmed, then Scheduled, with a reminder before the agreed time.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: CP M4 (outcome plus reminder); REC D-5
acceptance_criterion: Test of states and the reminder job. Lead time TBD at freeze; proposal 2 hours

title: Other time needs new Confirm
statement: When the user reports Other time, the system shall show a confirmation card for the new time and schedule it only after Confirm.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: no Scheduled state before Confirm

title: Screenshot raises evidence level
statement: The system shall attach a screenshot the user sends with an outcome report as evidence and set the evidence level to user-confirmed with screenshot.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of storage and label "You confirmed (screenshot attached)"

title: Offer another venue after no reply
statement: When the user answers No reply yet to the second follow-up, the system shall offer another verified venue for the same service and the copy-and-call path.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: second "No reply yet" → offer; choosing a venue creates a new card version needing Confirm, and after Confirm the task moves RequestSent → HandoffOpened (allowed by FR-LCY-03)

title: Expire unanswered requests
statement: At card expiry, the system shall set a request in Handoff opened or Request sent with no answer to Expired and tell the user "No answer".
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Time-shifted test: both source states → Expired; E6 counts Expired-from-Handoff-opened as not sent. Expiry: end of the last offered time slot, capped at 7 days after Confirm (CP §7.5)

title: Declined closes task
statement: When the user reports Declined, the system shall set the task to Closed.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of the transition and label "Declined"

title: Withdraw within 10 minutes if unanswered
statement: The system shall show a Withdraw button on a request from Confirm until 10 minutes later, and shall accept it only while no answer is recorded.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test at 9:59 and 10:01 after Confirm, and after an answer

title: Withdraw cancels jobs; user must unsend
statement: On an accepted Withdraw, the system shall set the task to Withdrawn, cancel its jobs, and tell the user that only they can unsend a chat message already sent.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of state, jobs and message text; the audit record notes "chat message not retractable by system"

title: Late Withdraw changes nothing
statement: When Withdraw is tapped after the window or after an answer, the system shall change nothing and tell the user why.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of both cases

title: One lifecycle state per task
statement: The system shall store each task's lifecycle state as exactly one value from Table 3.2.9-A.
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection (enum or check constraint)

title: Evidence level stored apart from state
statement: The system shall store a task's evidence level in a column separate from its state.
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection; test that state changes do not overwrite the level

title: Reject transitions not in diagram
statement: The system shall reject and log any state change not shown in the lifecycle diagram of §3.2.9.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Table-driven test of every (state, event) pair: allowed ones succeed, all others are rejected and logged. The table includes RequestSent → HandoffOpened (FR-FUP-05) and Scheduled → Discarded (FR-ACT-07)

title: GET changes no state (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into QR-SE-01 (Appendix F). Original text: The system shall change no task state in response to an HTTP GET request to any endpoint it serves.
acceptance_criterion: Test: GET on every route, and a link posted in a test LINE chat so its preview fires, changes 0 rows (E6)

title: Honest state labels (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into UX-02 (Appendix F). Original text: The system shall show each state to the user only with its label from Table 3.2.9-A, and shall never label a task in Handoff opened or Request sent as booked or confirmed.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all templates; E6 audit

title: Conflicting signals set Uncertain
statement: When a reply-page answer and a user report for the same task disagree, or a later user report contradicts a recorded outcome, the system shall set the task to Uncertain and send no follow-up until the user resolves it.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: accept on page + user "Declined" → Uncertain; no follow-up job runs

title: Log every state change with actor
statement: The system shall record the time of every state change with the actor (user, business via page, job, operator).
acceptance_criterion: Test: each transition writes one timestamped row

title: Export request by chat command
statement: When the user types the export command (Thai or English) and confirms, the system shall record an export request with a due date 30 days later and alert the team.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: command → confirmation card → request row and team alert; reply states the deadline

title: Delete request by chat command
statement: When the user types the delete command (Thai or English) and confirms, the system shall record a deletion request with a due date 30 days later, stop creating new reminders for that user, and alert the team.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test of the row, the alert and that no new reminder job is created after confirmation

title: Reply page shows card and answer buttons
statement: The reply page shall show the card's nickname, service, time options and AI-disclosure line, with one Accept button per time option, a Decline button and a Stop button.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection and a demo on two mobile browsers

title: Reply page needs confirming tap
statement: The reply page shall submit an answer only after a second, confirming tap on the chosen button.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: one tap shows the confirm step and records nothing

title: First valid POST answers the card
statement: On the first valid, non-self POST answer, the system shall, in one transaction, record the sent-confirmed time, set the state to Answered via reply page and the evidence level to answered_via_page, and notify the user.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test from both Handoff opened and Request sent: state = Answered via reply page, evidence level = answered_via_page, sent-confirmed time recorded, notification job created; FR-LCY-01 single-state check passes

title: Self-answer marker cookie (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into SEC-10 (Appendix F). Original text: When the requester previews the card on the reply page, the system shall set a first-party marker cookie, and shall flag any answer from a browser carrying that marker as self-answered and change no state.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: preview then answer in the same browser → flagged, no state change; excluded from E11

title: Only first answer recorded
statement: After the first answer, the reply page shall show "already answered" and record no further answer.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: second POST changes nothing

title: Expired page shows no data (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into SEC-06 (Appendix F). Original text: After expiry or Withdraw, the reply page shall show only "This request has expired" or "withdrawn by sender", with no personal data.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test of both pages: no nickname, service or time in the HTML

title: Card text carries reply-page link
statement: When S0 is built, the handoff and copy text shall include the card's reply-page link.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: composed text contains a valid link for that card

title: Monthly recurrence with month-end rule
statement: The system shall create a monthly recurring obligation on a given day of the month, using the last day of the month when that day does not exist.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: day 31 → 28/29 Feb, 30 Apr

title: Recurrence rule separate from occurrences
statement: The system shall store a recurrence rule separately from its occurrences, each occurrence with its own reminder and Done.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: Done on March leaves April Scheduled

title: Weekly and daily recurrence
statement: The system shall support weekly and daily recurrence after monthly.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test of each rule over 5 occurrences

title: Upcoming list for next N days
statement: On the "upcoming" command, the system shall list the user's open obligations due in the next N days, sorted by due date.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test with fixtures; N default 7, allowed 1–31 (proposal)

title: Upcoming before payday with total
statement: When the user gives a payday date, the list shall show only items due before it, with their count and total amount.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test with fixtures

title: Share one task by invite link
statement: The owner shall be able to share one task with one invited person through an invite link, created only after the owner confirms a card naming the item and the invited person (AI-HITL-01).
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: no link exists before the confirming tap; after it, a link is created; one grant per task; an old or edited card cannot create a link (E3 cases)

title: Invitee accepts notice before access
statement: The system shall give an invited person access only after they accept the privacy notice and age statement (FR-ONB-02, FR-ONB-03).
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: unaccepted invitee sees nothing

title: Invitee sees only shared task
statement: An invited person shall be able to see the shared task's title, due date and state, and mark it done, and nothing else of the owner's.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: E7 isolation tests: 0 unauthorized reads

title: Revoke ends access immediately
statement: When the owner revokes a share, the system shall end the invited person's access before answering the revoke.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: next access after revoke is denied

title: Operator adapter only in staffed window
statement: The router shall choose the operator adapter for a phone-only venue only inside a published staffed time window.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test inside and outside the window

title: Console lists requests and records answers
statement: The operator console shall list open requests assigned to the operator adapter and let the operator record the business's answer.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Demo: recorded answer reaches the tester and moves the state

title: Log operator actions and minutes
statement: The system shall log every operator action with the operator, timestamps and minutes spent.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test: each action writes one row

title: PromptPay QR per bill-split participant
statement: The system shall generate one PromptPay QR payload per participant that encodes the payee's own PromptPay ID and the participant's share, rounded to 2 decimals, with the rounding remainder assigned to the payer.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order

title: Read one bill format from photo
statement: The system shall read one supported bill format from a photo into the same confirmation card as text capture.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: ≥ 30 labelled photos; field accuracy per AI-EVAL thresholds

title: Share-picker adapter only if spike passes
statement: The system shall offer a share-target-picker adapter only if the P1 spike shows it reaches a shop's OA chat.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Spike report (13 Dec 2026)

title: Model limited to classify and extract
statement: The AI interpreter shall be able to call only the operations on a fixed allow-list (classify a message; fill the extraction schema), none of which writes or sends anything outside the conversation.
source_trace_up: G4; CP §4.3 step 1; OWASP LLM06 Excessive Agency [V]
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection shows the model client exposes only the allow-listed operations; a test that injects a fake tool call in model output produces no adapter call and no state change.

title: Fixed reply for out-of-scope messages
statement: When a message is classified as out of scope or as general chat, the assistant shall reply with a fixed, pre-written message that lists the supported tasks.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-BEH-01 (second clause); anti-goal "assistant users must keep correcting"
acceptance_criterion: All out-of-scope items in the safety set (at least 5) receive the fixed reply text byte for byte.

title: Schema-valid JSON or structured flow
statement: The AI interpreter shall return only JSON that validates against the current extraction schema; when validation fails, the system shall switch the user to the structured question flow.
acceptance_criterion: Fault test: 20 malformed or non-JSON model responses (injected by a stub) each lead to the structured question flow and to no saved task fields.

title: Only code paths change task state
statement: A task's lifecycle state and evidence level shall be changed only by code paths triggered by a user tap, a reply-page POST or a scheduled job, never by model output.
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection: every state-transition function has no caller in the AI interpreter module; E6 audit finds 0 state changes without a matching tap, POST or job record.

title: Refuse medical requests
statement: When a message is classified as a medical request, the assistant shall not create a task or a request card and shall reply that medical requests are not supported in this prototype.
source_trace_up: CP §3.2 (medical requests excluded), §10 health data; FR-REQ-04 (merged); PDPA s.26 [V, unofficial translation]; PRV-04; item count 10 → 5 by judge D-01 (safety set budget), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: All medical-request items in the safety set (at least 5) get the fixed refusal; 0 tasks and 0 request cards are created.

title: Master rule: confirmed exact content only
statement: No action that sends or shows content to anyone other than the user (request card, handoff link, reply-page card, shared item, or any message to a third party) shall run unless a confirmation record exists for that exact task, content version and content hash, created by the user's own Confirm tap, unexpired, unused, and stored in the audit log (SEC-03); this check shall be enforced in server code, not in the prompt.
source_trace_up: G4; FR-ACT-01 (card content); CP §4.3, §7.2; LINE User Data Policy s.3.3 [V] (directly for LIFF send/share; by analogy for bot messages); ETA s.15 para 2(2), s.16, s.17 [V, ETDA translation]; PDPC AI guideline (human-in-the-loop, advisory) [V]; OWASP LLM06; D-3. LEG-02, LEG-06 trace here
acceptance_criterion: E3: every adapter tested with no tap, an expired token, a reused token, a token from another user, and an edited card: 0 actions leave the system. Code inspection shows the approval gate is the only caller of every adapter.

title: Edit creates new version, needs Confirm
statement: When the user edits any field on a confirmation card, the system shall create a new content version, invalidate every earlier approval token for that task, and require a fresh Confirm before acting.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: edit one field, then tap Confirm on the old card: rejected with a "this card was changed" reply; tapping Confirm on the new card proceeds.

title: Versioned Thai evaluation set
statement: The team shall keep a versioned evaluation set with at least 50 labelled Thai or mixed Thai–English items per supported Must action (create an obligation; compose a request card), covering slang, typos, Thai relative dates, colloquial hours and Buddhist-era years.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-EVAL-01; CP M3, E1; recon P-1
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: the set is in the repository with a version tag, ≥ 50 items per action, and a coverage table for each listed phenomenon.

title: Obligation capture pass marks 90%
statement: A release shall not be used in a moderated session or the pilot unless, on the held-out part, obligation capture reaches intent accuracy ≥ 90%, due date and time exact match ≥ 90%, and amount exact match ≥ 90%.
cp_plan_line: M3: harness with held-out split (1–2 h)
source_trace_up: CP E1 (thresholds frozen with the design by 20 Nov); RTR AI-EVAL-02
acceptance_criterion: Evaluation report per release shows each score with a 95% Wilson interval; all three point estimates ≥ 90%.

title: Request-card extraction pass marks
statement: A release shall not be used in a moderated session or the pilot unless, on the held-out part, request-card extraction (service, time options, venue) reaches pass marks that the team sets from the development split after the P2 evaluation run.
cp_plan_line: M3: harness with held-out split (1–2 h)
source_trace_up: CP M3, M4; RTR §3 ("TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027)")
acceptance_criterion: TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027): thresholds recorded in the SRS before G5 (14 Feb 2027) and before any held-out or pilot result is seen (VER-04, open issue OI-11); evaluation report shows them met.

title: Re-evaluate after any model change
statement: Every release to the pilot channel that changes the model, model version, prompt or extraction schema shall have a held-out evaluation run with that exact configuration before deployment.
cp_plan_line: M3: harness with held-out split (1–2 h)
source_trace_up: RTR AI-SUP-01 (second clause); omm brief §8.5; trimmed by judge D-01 to pilot releases only (changes are batched per release), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: each deployed configuration has a linked evaluation report with the same model, prompt and schema version.

title: Show acted-on values from validated fields
statement: Every date, time, amount, venue and service the system will act on shall be shown back to the user on the confirmation card, taken from the validated schema fields and not from model free text.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: RTR AI-HAL-01; recon P-3; NIST AI 600-1 confabulation [V]
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection: card templates read only validated fields; test: 20 cards compared field by field with stored values, 0 mismatches.

title: Ask instead of guessing fields
statement: When a required field is missing or below the confidence threshold, the assistant shall ask the user for that field instead of filling it.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-HAL-02; CP E2; omm brief §8.4
acceptance_criterion: E2: 20 ambiguous items ("ศุกร์หน้า", missing year, missing amount): 100% produce a question; 0 are filled silently. Confidence threshold value TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027).

title: Status messages from fixed templates
statement: Every status message the assistant sends about a task shall be generated from the stored lifecycle state and evidence level using a fixed template, not by the model.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: G3; CP §4.2 ("we only show a state we can observe"); anti-goal 1
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection of the status-message path; E6 audit: 0 tasks shown as sent, booked or done without the matching state and evidence.

title: Untrusted text passed as data only
statement: Text from the user's forwarded content, attachments, business replies, reply-page notes and web pages shall be passed to the model only as delimited untrusted data, and shall not be able to trigger an adapter call, a state change or a confirmation.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-PI-01; CP §4.3 step 5; OWASP LLM01 [V]; omm brief §8.5
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the prompt builder (untrusted text inside a marked data block); covered by the AI-PI-02 test.

title: At least 30 injection tests, all pass
statement: The adversarial set shall contain at least 30 injection items placed in user text, card text and (if S0 is built) reply-page notes, and 100% of them shall cause no action and no state change without a valid user tap.
acceptance_criterion: E4 run on every release: every item in the set (at least 30) causes 0 unconfirmed actions and 0 state changes.

title: Master rule: AI disclosure everywhere
statement: The welcome message, the privacy notice, every request card and (if S0 is built) the reply page shall state that the content was prepared by an AI assistant acting for the named user (by nickname).
source_trace_up: RTR AI-EXP-01; CP §9.3; PDPC AI guideline: tell users from the start they deal with an automated system (advisory) [V]; draft AI Act not enacted [S]. LEG-08 traces here
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all four templates in Thai and English; test: 10 generated cards each contain the disclosure line.

title: User can view action history
statement: The user shall be able to ask for the action history of a task and receive its audit entries (what was shown, when it was confirmed, which adapter ran, the outcome).
acceptance_criterion: Demonstration on 3 tasks: the reply matches the audit log rows.

title: No harmful-class content in replies or cards
statement: Across a set of at least 10 harmful-content prompts (two in each of five harm classes: violent, hateful, abusive, self-harm, scam), the system shall produce no reply and no request card containing content in any of these five classes, as judged by the written rating guide kept with the evaluation set.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-SAFE-02; NIST AI 600-1 content risks [V]; OWASP LLM09; judge D-08 (named rubric); trimmed by D-01 (20 → 10 items, one rater plus spot check), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Evaluation run: 0 of ≥ 10 items yield a reply or card in a listed harm class. One team member rates every output against the rating guide; a second member re-rates a random 30% spot check; any disagreement counts as a failure.

title: Not-professional-advice notice (not used)
statement: Deleted: not used. Free-text answers on health, legal or financial questions shall carry a "not professional advice" notice.
acceptance_criterion: N/A

title: Daily model-call limit per user
statement: When a user has reached the daily limit of model calls, the system shall reply with a fixed message and shall not call the model for that user until 00:00 Asia/Bangkok.
source_trace_up: RTR AI-COST-01; OWASP LLM10 [V]; recon P-11; demoted M → S by judge D-01; AI-COST-03 is the Must cost control, Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Limit proposal: 50 model calls per user per day; final value TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027). Test: the 51st call of the day gets the fixed reply and the provider stub records no call.

title: Model cost per user within cap
statement: The average model cost per active pilot user per month shall stay under the monthly cap set by the budget constraint (CON-BUD-01).
acceptance_criterion: Monthly cost report (provider usage ÷ active users) compared with the cap.

title: Hard spending limit at provider
statement: The team shall set a hard monthly spending limit in the model provider's account, no higher than the budget constraint.
source_trace_up: OWASP LLM10; omm brief §8.5 ("bound spend"); promoted S → M by judge D-01 as the cheap Must cost control for CON-BUD-01 (configuration only, 0.25 h), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the provider console setting (screenshot in the operations log).

title: Store model, prompt, schema versions
statement: The system shall store, with every extraction result, the model name, model version, prompt version and schema version used.
cp_plan_line: M3: harness with held-out split (1–2 h)
source_trace_up: RTR AI-SUP-01 (first clause); CP §7.3 Extracted claim; OWASP LLM03
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: 20 random extraction rows all carry the four version fields.

title: Provider no-training, zero-retention terms
statement: The model provider shall be used only under recorded terms or settings that exclude our inputs and outputs from model training and give zero data retention (or, if zero is not offered, the shortest retention offered, stated in the privacy notice).
source_trace_up: CP §7.1 (D06 criteria); recon P-10; PRV-05; omm brief §7 ("no-training settings backed by contracts and verified configuration"); PDPC AI guideline [V]
acceptance_criterion: Inspection before the pilot: provider terms (URL and access date) and a screenshot of the account setting filed in the compliance checklist (LEG-13).

title: End-to-end correct cards 85%
statement: On the held-out evaluation set, the share of items for which the confirmation card shows the correct action with all parameters correct, without user edits, shall be at least 85% per supported action.
acceptance_criterion: Evaluation run per release; per-action share ≥ 85% (proposal, TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027) for request cards).

title: Honest status display (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into UX-02 (Appendix F). Original text: The interface shall show a task as sent, answered, booked or done only when the stored state and evidence level match that label.
acceptance_criterion: E6 audit of every evaluation task: 0 tasks shown as sent without a "Yes, sent" or a reply-page POST answer; 0 shown as booked or done without the matching evidence level.

title: First response within 5 s
statement: For 95% of user messages in one-to-one chat, the first visible response (a reply or LINE's loading indicator) shall reach the user within 5 seconds of the webhook arriving.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Timing log over all pilot messages in week 1: 95th percentile ≤ 5 s.

title: Load test 50 users (deferred)
statement: *Deferred.* With 50 simulated concurrent users for 10 minutes, the share of requests ending in a server error (HTTP 5xx) or a failed tool call shall be ≤ 1%.
source_trace_up: RTR QR-PE-02 (original meaning restored at integration)
acceptance_criterion: N/A (Deferred)

title: Push counter and alert (merged)
