statement: Deleted: merged into OPS-06 and IF-LINE-06 (Appendix F). Original text: The system shall count push messages per tester per calendar month and alert the team when 80% of the OA plan's monthly push quota is reached.
source_trace_up: CP TD5, E5; recon P-11; omm brief §8.8 (Free plan 300 pushes a month [V])
acceptance_criterion: Test with a lowered quota setting: the alert fires at 80%; monthly report lists pushes per tester (target ≤ 40 per tester per month, or the TD5 cap).

title: Handoff works on iOS and Android
statement: The LINE handoff link shall open the venue's chat with the pre-filled Thai text on the current LINE app for iOS and for Android.
source_trace_up: CP §4.4 (oaMessage, mobile only [V]), M1 P1 spike
acceptance_criterion: P1 spike and pre-pilot check on at least one iOS and one Android phone per tester platform in use: 100% open the right chat with the text intact.

title: Copy fallback when handoff fails (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into IF-OAM-03 and CON-PLAT-02 (Appendix F). Original text: When the handoff link cannot be used (no known LINE ID, or LINE for PC), the system shall offer the copy-and-send fallback instead.
acceptance_criterion: Test: a venue with no LINE ID and a simulated PC client each receive the copy fallback.

title: Help in one tap from rich menu
statement: A first-time user shall be able to open "what can you do?" help from the rich menu in one tap.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: RTR QR-IC-01 (restored at integration; referenced in §3.4.4.1); §3.1.1 rich menu (Help); demoted M → S by judge D-01, then restored to M at the judge re-check: the rich menu is needed anyway for the privacy link (LEG-01), so the Help button costs about nothing (inside the CP M5 line "privacy, retention, delete script"), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the rich menu; in each moderated session the participant reaches help in one tap.

title: Error messages give a next step
statement: Every error message shall state what failed and give one next step the user can take.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: RTR QR-IC-02; anti-goal "failure the user is not told about"
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all error templates (Thai and English): 100% name the failure and one next step.

title: Tap-only flow after first reply
statement: After the assistant's first reply in a task, the user shall be able to choose an option, confirm, cancel, withdraw and pick the field to edit with quick-reply or card buttons alone, without typing.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: In the demo script for M2 and M4, every step after the first reply is completed by taps only, except entering a new free-text value; test log shows no other typed step

title: Fixed honest status labels
statement: Every message and card that shows a task's status shall use the fixed label for that state from Table 3.2.9-A (§3.2.9), in Thai and English, and shall never use "booked", "จองแล้ว", "sent" or "ส่งแล้ว" for a state below the one that label belongs to.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: each status template maps to exactly one state in the label table. E6 audit: 0 tasks shown as sent without "Yes, sent" or a POST answer, 0 shown as booked or done without the matching evidence level

title: Cards say what, to whom, when
statement: Each confirmation card and request card shall state, in one plain sentence above its buttons, what will happen, to whom and when.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: FR-ACT-01; AI-HITL-01; CP §3.3 anti-goal "assistant users must keep correcting"
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all card templates against a three-point checklist (what, to whom, when). In each of the 3 moderated sessions, the participant correctly explains, before tapping Confirm, what the card will do (3 of 3)

title: Testers complete flows unaided (E8)
statement: Testers shall complete the capture → confirm → reminder flow without help from the team.
acceptance_criterion: E8: share of pilot testers who complete the flow unaided ≥ 80% (point estimate), reported with a 95% Wilson interval and the §4.4 outcome label. Second measure, same rule: ≥ 70% take a request to a known outcome (answered, declined or clearly no reply)

title: Median capture time 2 minutes (E9)
statement: A message shall become a confirmed, tracked task within 2 minutes (median), counted from the user's first message to the Confirm tap.
acceptance_criterion: E9: median ≤ 2 min over all tester captures in the pilot, with a 95% distribution-free (order-statistic) interval reported

title: SUS mean at least 68
statement: Testers' mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score shall be at least 68.
acceptance_criterion: E10: SUS from all testers; mean ≥ 68 (point estimate) with a 95% t-interval reported and the §4.4 outcome label. With n = 15–20 the half-width is about ±8 (n = 20) to ±9.4 (n = 15) points [I, assuming SD ≈ 17]

title: At most 40 pushes per tester-month
statement: The assistant shall send no more than 40 push messages per tester per month.
source_trace_up: E5; jui's ≤ 40 target (CP E5); anti-goal "reminders that become another source of stress"
acceptance_criterion: E5 push counter: maximum pushes for any tester in any calendar month ≤ 40; the distribution per tester is reported

title: Reply in language of last message
statement: The assistant shall reply to the user in the language (Thai or English) of the user's last message.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: RTR L10N-01; TD1 testers; the "fix language" command moved to L10N-08 (S) by judge D-01
acceptance_criterion: Test: 20 scripted turns (10 Thai, 10 English, including a language switch) produce replies in the expected language 20 of 20 times. Mixed messages follow the language of the majority of words, a rule written in the test spec

title: Fix reply language by command
statement: The user shall be able to fix the reply language (Thai or English) with a chat command.
source_trace_up: Split from L10N-01 by judge D-01 (not in a CP Must line)
acceptance_criterion: Test: after the fix command, 5 turns in the other language get replies in the fixed language

title: Accept and show BE and CE years
statement: The assistant shall accept Buddhist-era (BE) and Common-era (CE) years and shall show every date in a confirmation card in both forms, for example "จ. 14 ธ.ค. 2569 / Mon 14 Dec 2026".
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests: 2569 and 2026 give the same date; "5 ม.ค. 2570" gives 5 Jan 2027 (a Tuesday). Every card template renders both forms. Year items in E1 meet the E1 date target

title: Thai months, days and clock words
statement: The assistant shall interpret all 12 Thai month names in full and abbreviated form, Thai relative day words (วันนี้, พรุ่งนี้, มะรืน) and Thai clock words (โมงเช้า, เที่ยง, บ่าย…โมง, …ทุ่ม, ตี…), and shall ask the user when a date word is ambiguous (for example ศุกร์หน้า, or a two-digit year such as "69").
source_trace_up: CP §6.1 M2; AI-HAL-02; E2; black-box script T04–T08, T42
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests: 24 month forms map correctly (24 of 24); clock-word table maps correctly (100%). The ambiguity rule is measured by E2 (100% of 20 ambiguous items are asked)

title: Bangkok display, UTC storage
statement: The system shall interpret and display every date and time in the Asia/Bangkok time zone (UTC+7) and store every instant in UTC.
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests run with the server zone set to UTC and to another zone give identical displayed times; a reminder set for "พรุ่งนี้ 9 โมง" fires at 09:00 Bangkok time within the FR-REM-01 tolerance; a set of 20 date cases, including midnight and Buddhist-era years, gives 0 shifted instants

title: Accept and format baht amounts
statement: The assistant shall accept baht amounts written with or without thousands separators, decimals, "บาท", "฿" or "THB", and shall show amounts in cards as a number with thousands separators followed by "บาท" (Thai) or "THB" (English).
source_trace_up: CP §8.1 example "ค่าไฟ 1,245 บาท"; E1 amount target
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests on at least 10 written forms; E1 amount exact-match target

title: Business card text in polite Thai
statement: Request-card text addressed to a business shall be written in polite Thai by default, whatever the user's chat language, and the user shall be able to switch that card to English before confirming.
source_trace_up: CP §4.4 (Thai pre-filled text); TD2 shops near campus
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the card template; test: an English-speaking user's card is Thai unless switched; switching creates a new card version needing a new Confirm (AI-HITL-02)

title: Accept Thai digits
statement: The assistant shall accept Thai digits (๐–๙) in dates, times and amounts.
acceptance_criterion: Unit tests with Thai-digit inputs give the same result as Arabic digits

title: Privacy page meets WCAG 2.2 AA
statement: The privacy-notice web page shall meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum).
source_trace_up: RTR A11Y-01; LEG-01; STK-03; judge D-08; demoted to Should by D-01 (not in a CP Must line; not legally required for this prototype), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: An automated checker (axe-core or similar) reports 0 violations for the WCAG 2.2 A and AA rules; page language is set (lang="th" or "en"); text reflows at 320 CSS px width. A manual TalkBack or VoiceOver check is done if hours allow

title: S0 and C5 pages meet WCAG 2.2 AA
statement: The S0 reply page and any C5 LIFF page that is built shall meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, including 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) and 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum).
conditional: S0, C5; Must for any such page that is built
acceptance_criterion: (a) Automated checker: 0 WCAG 2.2 A and AA violations per page; (b) manual check: TalkBack or VoiceOver reads every control with a name, targets at least 24 × 24 CSS px (our reading of 2.5.8, to recheck), reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom, page language set. The reply page has no login, so 3.3.8 is met by design (OOS-08)

title: Alternative text on every Flex message
statement: Every Flex message shall carry alternative text that states, in plain words, the card's action and its date or status.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: LINE Flex altText field (required by the API, UNVERIFIED in this run); UX-03; IF-UI-01 (merged)
acceptance_criterion: Unit test over all card templates: alternative text is non-empty and contains the action word and the date or status label

title: Status never by colour alone
statement: Status and warnings shall be stated in words, never by colour, icon or emoji alone.
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: WCAG 1.4.1 Use of Color (for web pages); UX-02
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all templates and pages: every coloured or icon-only cue has a text equivalent

title: Redelivered events cause no duplicates
statement: A redelivered or out-of-order LINE webhook event shall never create a second task, reminder, card or state change.
source_trace_up: RTR QR-RE-01; CP §7.1 Ingress, §7.5; omm brief §8.1 (dedupe on webhookEventId [V])
acceptance_criterion: §9.2 test: ≥ 100 replayed and reordered events: 0 duplicate rows or messages.

title: Pilot availability 99% per week
statement: Pilot service availability shall be at least 99% per week, measured by an external uptime check every 5 minutes.
source_trace_up: RTR QR-RE-02 (original meaning restored at integration)
acceptance_criterion: Uptime log for each pilot week ≥ 99%.

title: Each job's effect runs once
statement: Each scheduled job shall run its external effect at most once, even when a worker stops mid-job and another worker reclaims it.
source_trace_up: CP §7.1 Job worker (idempotency key, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED); omm brief §8.6
acceptance_criterion: Fault test: kill the worker during 50 jobs; every job completes once; 0 duplicate pushes.

title: Master quiet-hours rule for system pushes
statement: (MASTER for quiet hours, decision D5.) A system-scheduled push (one the user did not time explicitly: follow-up, expiry notice, nudge, digest, repeat after snooze) that falls inside the user's quiet hours shall be sent at the end of the quiet period instead.
source_trace_up: Decision D5; FR-REM-02; CP M2 (quiet hours); omm brief §8.8; anti-goal "reminders that become stress"
acceptance_criterion: Test with quiet hours 22:00–07:00 (proposed default): a follow-up due at 23:30 is sent at 07:00 ± 60 s; a user-set 23:00 reminder is sent at 23:00 ± 60 s.

title: Pause pushes after unfollow (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into IF-LINE-07 (Appendix F). Original text: When the user unfollows or blocks the OA, the system shall pause all of that user's scheduled pushes until the user follows again.
acceptance_criterion: Test: unfollow event, then a due reminder: no push call made; refollow: schedule resumes.

title: Reminders work during LLM outage
statement: While the model provider is unavailable, already-scheduled reminders shall still be delivered, and new messages shall be handled by the structured question flow.
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
acceptance_criterion: Fault test: provider stub returns errors for 30 min; 100% of due reminders sent; new captures go to the structured flow.

title: Availability (renumbered to QR-RE-02)
statement: Deleted: merged into QR-RE-02 (renumbered to its RTR meaning) (Appendix F). Original text: Pilot service availability shall be at least 99% per week, measured by an external uptime check every 5 minutes.
acceptance_criterion: Uptime log for each pilot week ≥ 99%.

title: GET or HEAD never changes state
statement: An HTTP GET or HEAD request to any URL the system serves shall not change task state, approvals, answers or evidence; access logging is allowed.
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
source_trace_up: Pending fix 1; FR-LCY-04 (merged); CP §7.5, E6, §9.2; risk "reply page triggered by link previews"; judge D-05
acceptance_criterion: Link-preview test: post each link type into a test LINE chat and fetch it with 3 common preview user agents: 0 changes to task state, approvals, answers or evidence (access-log lines only).

title: State changes only via verified paths
statement: The system shall change task state, approvals, answers or evidence only in response to a signature-verified LINE event, a POST request carrying a valid token, or a scheduled job.
source_trace_up: Judge D-05 (second clause of QR-SE-01); AI-BEH-04; IF-LINE-01; IF-RP-01 (reply-page POST, S0)
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection of every state-changing handler; table-driven test: each route rejects state changes from any other request type.

title: Common adapter interface with tests
statement: Every channel adapter shall implement the same interface (prepare, handoff, record_outcome) and have its own unit tests.
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection; CI report shows tests per adapter.

title: Model changeable by configuration
statement: The model provider and model shall be changeable by configuration only, with no code change.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
source_trace_up: RTR QR-MA-02; CP C6; S → C to match its parent CP C6 (judge note)
acceptance_criterion: Demonstration: switch to a second model by config; evaluation harness runs unchanged.

title: Local setup under 60 minutes
statement: A team member shall be able to run the whole system locally from the README in under 60 minutes.
acceptance_criterion: Timed run by one member who did not write the setup.

title: Fail safe with no partial action
statement: If the model, an adapter or the database fails during an action, the system shall leave no partial external action and shall tell the user what did and did not happen.
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
acceptance_criterion: Fault injection at each step of the request flow: 0 partial actions; the user message names the completed and failed steps.

title: Warn on unknown PromptPay ID
statement: When a bill split or request would show a PromptPay ID that the user has not confirmed before (an "unknown account"), the confirmation card shall show a warning naming that ID.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
acceptance_criterion: Test (if C2 is built): a card with a new PromptPay ID shows the warning; a previously confirmed ID does not.

title: Uncertain blocks retries
statement: A task in the Uncertain state shall block any retry or new handoff for that task until the user resolves it.
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: CP §4.2 ("must be resolved before any retry"); omm brief §8.6 (reconcile before resubmitting)
acceptance_criterion: Test: put a task in Uncertain; a retry command is refused with a resolve prompt.

title: Data dictionary in SRS v1.0
statement: The SRS v1.0 shall include a data dictionary listing every stored entity and field with its type, whether it is personal data, its PDPA lawful basis and its retention row from Table R.
cp_plan_line: M7: report, demo, handover (design docs kept current) (12–16 h)
source_trace_up: RTR DR-01; PDPA s.23 (notice of retention) [V]
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: every table in the schema appears in the dictionary; every personal field has a basis and a retention row.

title: Venue facts carry source and date
statement: Each venue row shall record the source of each contact fact (the shop's own sign, page or OA profile) and the date it was last checked by hand.
source_trace_up: CP §4.4, §7.3 Venue; Google Maps Platform ToS s.3.2.3 [V, via CP §10]; SEED-LEG-01
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of all 10–15 venue rows: 100% have a source note and a date.

title: Extracted claims stored apart
statement: Extracted claims shall be stored apart from the confirmed task fields, with their confidence and source span.
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection; test: editing a confirmed field does not change the stored claim.

title: Delete data per retention table
statement: The system shall delete or anonymise each data class in Table R no later than the limit in that row, applying the precedence rules below the table.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: RTR DR-04; CP §7.4; PDPA s.23, s.37 [V]; TR-03
acceptance_criterion: Retention jobs tested with time-shifted data, one test per row: 100% of expired rows deleted or anonymised; nothing deleted early.

title: Re-apply deletions after restore
statement: After a backup is restored, the system shall re-apply every deletion recorded since that backup was taken before the restored data is used.
source_trace_up: omm brief §8.9 (deleted data must not reappear after restore); OPS-05 restore drill
acceptance_criterion: Restore drill: delete a test user, restore an earlier backup, run the re-apply step: the user's data is absent.

title: Bill-split amounts in satang
statement: Each participant amount in a bill split shall be stored as an integer number of satang.
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection.

title: Delete LINE profile data within 24 h
statement: Profile and membership information obtained from LINE friend or group APIs shall be deleted within 24 hours of retrieval.
source_trace_up: RTR DR-07; LINE User Data Policy s.3.2.3 [V]
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: no such fields persisted beyond a 24-hour cache; retention test if any are added.

title: Obligation amounts in satang
statement: Every obligation amount shall be stored as an integer number of satang.
source_trace_up: CP §4.3 step 2 (amounts validated as numbers); E1 amount exact match
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection; test: "1,245.50 บาท" stored as 124550.

title: UTC storage, Bangkok display (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into L10N-04 (Appendix F). Original text: Every stored instant shall be in UTC, and every date shown to or parsed from the user shall use the Asia/Bangkok time zone.
acceptance_criterion: Test set of 20 date cases, including midnight and Buddhist-era years: 0 shifted instants.

title: Keep evidence level after deletion (merged)
statement: Deleted: merged into FR-EVD-04 (Appendix F). Original text: After an evidence image is deleted under Table R, the task's evidence level shall be kept and its label shall change to "slip was attached (deleted per retention)".
acceptance_criterion: Retention test on a task with a slip: image gone, evidence level unchanged, new label shown.

title: Secrets only in secret store
statement: Secrets (LINE channel secret and access token, model API key, database credentials) shall be held only in the deployment's secret store, never in the repository, logs or model context.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
source_trace_up: RTR SEC-01; CP M1; omm brief §8.1, §8.5; LINE Developers Agreement §5.2.2 [V]
acceptance_criterion: Secret scan of the repository and a week of logs finds 0 secrets; prompt-builder inspection.

title: HTTPS only
statement: Every endpoint the system exposes shall accept connections only over HTTPS.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Test: plain HTTP requests are refused or redirected without serving content.

title: Append-only audit log
statement: Every confirmation, adapter call, state change, operator action and rights request shall be written to an append-only audit log with actor, action, references, preview hash and timestamp, and minimal personal content.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: the application role has no UPDATE or DELETE on the audit table except the retention job; test: each listed event creates one row.

title: Approval tokens strong, hashed, single-use
statement: Each approval token shall be random with at least 128 bits, stored only as a hash, valid for one use, and expire after a set time.
acceptance_criterion: Expiry: the value set in FR-ACT-06 (proposal 60 minutes, TBD at freeze, 20 Nov 2026). Tests: reused, expired and modified tokens all rejected (part of E3).

title: Reply-page tokens strong and card-bound
statement: Each reply-page token shall be random with at least 128 bits, stored only as a hash, and tied to exactly one request card.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: a token for card A cannot read or answer card B; database inspection shows hashes only.

title: Expired reply page shows no data
statement: After a card expires (end of the last offered slot, at most 7 days) or is withdrawn, the reply page shall show only "This request has expired" or "Withdrawn by sender", with no personal data.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test on expired and withdrawn cards: the response body contains no nickname, service or time options.

title: Reply-page headers, no third-party scripts
statement: The reply page shall send Referrer-Policy: no-referrer, a noindex header and meta tag, and a Content Security Policy that allows only our own scripts, and shall load no third-party scripts, analytics or fonts.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Header test on the deployed page; inspection of the page source for external hosts: 0 found.

title: Tokens never logged
statement: Tokens shall never be written to logs; request paths that contain tokens shall be redacted in access logs.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Log inspection after a test session: 0 full tokens found.

title: Reply-page rate limits
statement: The reply page shall enforce rate limits per card and per IP address.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Proposed limits: 10 POSTs per card per hour; 60 requests per IP per minute (TBD after P2 run (24 Jan 2027)). Test: requests above the limit get HTTP 429 and no state change.

title: Flag self-answers by marker cookie
statement: When the requester previews their own card, the reply page shall set a first-party marker cookie on that device, and any answer posted from a browser carrying that marker shall be stored with the self-answered flag.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
acceptance_criterion: Test: answer from the requester's browser is flagged and excluded from E11; answer from a clean browser is not flagged.

title: Encryption at rest
statement: The database and object storage shall be encrypted at rest with provider-managed keys.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the hosting configuration.

title: Owner filter on every data access
statement: Every read or write of user data shall be filtered in server code by the verified owner (or, with S1, by an active sharing grant).
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
acceptance_criterion: E7 cross-user tests (≥ 20 cases, plus revoked-share cases if S1 is built): 0 unauthorized reads.

title: Identity only from verified sources
statement: The server shall take a LINE user's identity only from a signature-verified webhook event or, for LIFF pages, from a server-verified ID token.
acceptance_criterion: Code inspection; test: a request with a forged user ID in the body is rejected.

title: Operator console 2FA and least privilege
statement: The operator console shall require team accounts with two-factor sign-in and shall show an operator only the requests assigned for a call and the fields needed for that call.
conditional: Built only if hours allow, in TD3 order
source_trace_up: CP S2, §7.1; omm brief §8.9 (least-privilege admin access)
acceptance_criterion: Demonstration: sign-in without the second factor fails; an operator view lists only assigned requests.

title: CI secret and dependency scanning
statement: The CI pipeline shall run secret scanning and dependency vulnerability scanning on every merge to the main branch.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of CI configuration and one run log.

title: Privacy notice before first use
statement: Before first use, the system shall show a privacy notice covering purposes, data collected, retention (Table R), recipients (the model provider abroad, and businesses that receive cards), AI disclosure and user rights.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the notice (Thai and English) against this list; test: no task is processed before the notice is acknowledged.

title: Record PDPA s.28 transfer basis
statement: The team shall record which PDPA s.28 basis covers sending prompts to the model provider outside Thailand, and the notice shall say that the transfer happens.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: basis recorded in the compliance checklist with the adviser's note; notice text names the transfer.

title: Export or delete within 30 days
statement: A user shall be able to request a copy (in a machine-readable format) or deletion of their data by chat command, and the team shall fulfil either request within 30 days.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: RTR PRV-03; CP M5; PDPA s.30 (access, 30 days) [V], s.31 (portability) [V], s.33 (erasure) [V]. PDPA s.33 sets no fixed period in our reading, so we commit to 30 days; the PDPC AI guideline's 90 days concerns data inside a trained model, which we do not have (judge D-11); recon P-8
acceptance_criterion: Test: export and delete commands on a test user; the export is JSON with all R3 data; after delete, only R8 audit rows remain; rights-request log shows fulfilment within 30 days.

title: No ID-card or health images kept
statement: The system shall not store images of ID cards or health documents beyond the task that needed them.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of evidence handling; the consent pack and in-chat prompt tell testers not to send them; any such image found in the E6 audit is deleted and logged.

title: No training on chat logs
statement: Chat logs shall not be used to train or fine-tune any model; the prototype offers no training opt-in, and use of the assistant shall never depend on one.
source_trace_up: RTR PRV-05; PDPC AI guideline (no bundled consent) [V]; AI-SUP-02
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of code, provider settings and the notice.

title: Minimal data on bill-split non-users
statement: Data about bill-split participants who are not users shall be limited to display name and amount owed, and deleted per Table R row R13.
acceptance_criterion: Schema inspection and retention test (if C2 is built).

title: Withdraw consent by chat command
statement: The user shall be able to withdraw consent and leave the service by chat command, after which the system shall stop processing that user's data and delete all LINE user information, including the LINE user ID, except minimal audit records kept for inquiries (R8).
source_trace_up: RTR PRV-07; PDPA s.19 [V]; LINE User Data Policy s.3.2.10, s.3.5.2 [V]
acceptance_criterion: Test: withdraw command; pending jobs cancelled; user row and tasks deleted; only R8 rows remain.

title: Separate consent screen
statement: Where consent is the lawful basis, it shall be requested on its own screen, separate from other terms, in Thai or English, with the purpose stated.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the onboarding flow.

title: Reply page collects minimal business data
statement: The reply page shall collect no data about the business person other than the answer, an optional short note and the time received, and shall not use LINE Login or LIFF.
conditional: Promote to M if TD6 finds scenario B or better (S0)
source_trace_up: Pending fix 2; CP §7.5, STK-03 (no sign-up); CP §9.3 (businesses are third-party data subjects)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the page and the Business reply schema; network capture shows no LINE Login call.

title: No personal content in logs
statement: Routine application logs shall contain no message text, nicknames, phone numbers or image content.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Log inspection after a scripted test session: 0 matches for the test session's message text, nickname and phone number.

title: Minimum context sent to LLM
statement: The system shall send to the model only the current message text, the current task's draft fields and the current date and time, and never LINE user IDs, display names, nicknames, secrets, other tasks or other users' data.
source_trace_up: IF-LLM-02 (merged); omm brief §8.5 (minimum context); PDPC AI guideline (prompts can be personal data) [S]; OWASP LLM02
acceptance_criterion: Prompt-builder inspection; test: captured prompts for 20 messages contain no LINE user ID, display name, nickname or other task's data.

title: Log every rights request
statement: The team shall record every PDPA rights request with its type, date received and date fulfilled.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: PDPA s.30, s.33 [V]; omm brief §7 (rights-request workflow)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the rights-request table after the PRV-03 test.

title: Privacy policy always reachable
statement: The service shall publish a privacy policy reachable from the rich menu and the welcome message.
source_trace_up: Privacy policy viewable at any time, before and after use (LINE User Data Policy s.2.2, s.2.4 [V]; PDPA s.23 [V])
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: PRV-01

title: No proxy sending without confirmation
statement: The system shall send nothing on the user's behalf without the user's confirmed tap on the exact content.
source_trace_up: No proxy sending via the user's account against their wishes; show details first (LINE User Data Policy s.3.3 [V]; directly for LIFF send/share, by analogy for bot messages)
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: AI-HITL-01; handoff is sent by the user's own tap

title: Never hold or move money
statement: The system shall not hold or move money; any PromptPay QR (C2) shall pay the payer's own account.
source_trace_up: Payment Systems Act and e-money rules [S, omm brief §7]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Design (no payment adapter); DR-06; C2 scope

title: University approvals before pilot
statement: The team shall obtain the approvals the university requires before any pilot, with an application that covers testers and businesses that receive cards as third-party data subjects.
cp_plan_line: M6: ethics and consent incl. businesses (3–5 h)
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: CP M6, §9.3

title: Testers sui juris (20+ or married)
statement: Pilot testers shall be aged 20 or over, or married (sui juris).
source_trace_up: Majority at 20 or by marriage (Civil and Commercial Code s.19, s.20 [S]); PDPA s.20 minors' consent [V]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Age confirmation stored in Consent (E-2); recruitment screening

title: ETA attribution: confirm exact content
statement: The user shall see and confirm the exact content before any message leaves. Whether our bot counts as the user's system needs legal review.
source_trace_up: ETA s.15 para 2(2), s.16, s.17 [V, ETDA translation]: messages from a system programmed to act for the user are the user's, and the receiver may rely on them
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: AI-HITL-01, AI-HAL-01, SEC-03

title: Edit, Cancel and 10-minute Withdraw
statement: Every confirmation card shall offer Edit and Cancel, and for 10 minutes after a confirmed request that has no known answer the user shall be able to Withdraw it, with the system stating that a chat message already sent can only be unsent by the user in LINE.
source_trace_up: ETA s.17/1 [V, ETA No. 3 translation]: input-error withdrawal where no correction channel exists (used as design basis, not a claim of coverage)
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Flow "Withdraw" (CP §7.2); AI-HITL-02

title: PDPC guideline AI disclosure
statement: Disclosure in welcome message, notice, every card and reply page.
source_trace_up: PDPC AI guideline (advisory, 7 Oct 2026) [V]: disclose the automated system from the start
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: AI-EXP-01

title: Re-check draft AI Act each gate
statement: The team shall re-check its status at each phase gate and, if enacted, check whether the reported research carve-out applies.
source_trace_up: Draft Thai AI Act: not enacted as of 9 Nov 2026 [S]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Phase-gate checklist

title: No Places or Wongnai content stored
statement: No Google Places or Wongnai content shall be stored in the venue table, test sets or non-Google maps; at most a Google place ID is stored, and Places details, if shown, are fetched at display time with attribution.
source_trace_up: Google Maps Platform ToS s.3.2.3 and Places policies; Wongnai ToS item (3) [V, via CP §10]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: DR-02; SEED-LEG-01; evaluation-set rule (§3.3.3)

title: Businesses can stop requests
statement: Every request card shall offer the business a way to stop further requests, and a Stop answer shall block further cards to that venue.
source_trace_up: Computer-Related Crime Act s.11 (unwanted messages) [S, via jui legal file]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Venue stop flag (E-8); reply-page Stop (FR-RP-01); STK-04, FR-RTE-04; in-chat stop wording for handoff cards

title: 72-hour breach notice procedure
statement: The team shall follow an incident procedure that includes the 72-hour notice step.
source_trace_up: PDPA s.37(4) [V]: breach notice to the Office within 72 hours where feasible
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: OPS-04

title: Cross-border transfer basis and terms
statement: Transfer basis recorded; provider no-training and zero-retention terms filed.
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: PRV-02, AI-SUP-02

title: LINE data deletion rules
statement: Friend and group information deleted within 24 hours; LINE user information deleted when a user leaves, except inquiry records.
source_trace_up: LINE User Data Policy s.3.2.3, s.3.2.10, s.3.5.2 [V]
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: DR-07, PRV-07

title: PDPA consent, health data, rights
statement: Unbundled consent; no health data; access and erasure within 30 days.
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: PRV-08, PRV-04, AI-SAFE-03, PRV-03

title: Traffic-data retention advice (open)
statement: Open issue. The team shall get advice on whether the prototype is a "service provider" before the pilot, and apply Table R row R16 if it is.
source_trace_up: Computer-Related Crime Act s.26 [S]: traffic data kept ≥ 90 days by service providers
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: Table R16

title: Secure storage; report unauthorised access
statement: User data shall be protected by the §3.6 controls, and unauthorised access shall be reported to LINE as part of the incident procedure.
source_trace_up: LINE Developers Agreement §5.2.2 [V]: store user data securely; report unauthorised access
acceptance_criterion: Compliance checklist review (team and advisor) before the pilot confirms the rule is met by: SEC-01, SEC-11, SEC-12; OPS-04

title: Separate development and pilot channels
statement: There shall be separate development and pilot LINE channels, with separate secrets and databases, so that tests never message pilot users.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at G3: two channels, two configurations; a test run on the development channel produces 0 pushes on the pilot channel's counter

title: Onboarding median under 3 minutes
statement: Pilot onboarding (add friend → privacy notice → consent on its own screen → first task) shall take a median of under 3 minutes.
acceptance_criterion: Timed in the 3 moderated sessions and from event timestamps for all testers; median < 3 min

title: Delete pilot data within 30 days
statement: At the end of the pilot, the team shall delete or anonymise all pilot data within 30 days and tell users how; audit logs and anonymised evaluation data are kept until the evaluation report is submitted, then deleted; every shorter limit still applies.
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
source_trace_up: RTR TR-03; CP §7.4; PDPA s.37(3) [V, via RTR]
acceptance_criterion: A deletion script is run and logged within 30 days of the pilot's end; a database query after the run finds no pilot personal data except the retained audit records; the closing message (TR-05) was sent

title: Activate testers only after consent recorded
statement: A tester's pilot access shall be activated only after the team has recorded, outside the repository, that the tester's consent and age-eligibility confirmation exist.
cp_plan_line: M6: ethics and consent incl. businesses (3–5 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection before G6 and weekly in P5: every active pilot user has a matching consent record; 0 exceptions

title: Closing message; cancel pushes at end
statement: When the pilot ends, the system shall send each tester one closing message saying that the pilot has ended, what will happen to their data and when, and how to ask for an export, and shall then cancel all scheduled pushes for that tester.
acceptance_criterion: Test on the development channel, then a pilot-channel log showing one closing message per tester and 0 jobs left scheduled

title: Seed 10-15 hand-checked venues
statement: Before P5, the venue table shall be seeded with 10–15 venues whose name, LINE ID or phone and opening hours were hand-checked from the shop's own sign, page or OA profile, each with a last-verified date.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection: 10–15 rows, each with a source note and a last-verified date within 30 days before the evaluation starts

title: Tell friendly shops start and end
statement: The friendly shops shall be told before the pilot that request cards may arrive, and told after the pilot that it has ended; a Stop answer shall block further cards to that venue.
acceptance_criterion: Records of the start and end notices; a test that a Stop answer blocks a new card to that venue

title: No testers before G6 sign-off
statement: No real tester shall be given access before the G6 readiness checklist is signed off.
acceptance_criterion: The G6 record is dated before the first pilot user's follow event

title: Alerts within 5 minutes
statement: Failed webhook handling, failed jobs, failed pushes and LLM errors shall raise an alert in the team's chat within 5 minutes.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Alert drill before G6: each of the four faults is injected on the development channel and an alert arrives within 5 minutes (4 of 4)

title: Daily database backup
statement: The database shall be backed up at least once a day.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
acceptance_criterion: Backup log shows one successful backup per day over any 14-day window in P4–P5

title: Restore drill before G6
statement: Before G6, the team shall restore the database from a daily backup in a drill and record the time taken.
source_trace_up: RTR OPS-02; charter acceptance "Recovery"; CP M5
acceptance_criterion: Drill record: restore completed within 4 staffed working hours, data loss ≤ 24 hours, and a check query confirms the restored task count

title: Help command; answer in 2 working days
statement: A tester shall be able to type "help" or "ติดต่อทีม" to reach the team, and the team shall answer within 2 working days during the pilot.
source_trace_up: RTR OPS-03; CP M6 (OPS-03 pilot support); charter §11
acceptance_criterion: Support log for P5: every request answered within 2 working days; the welcome message states the window

title: Incident procedure with 72-hour notice
statement: The team shall keep a one-page incident procedure that includes notifying the PDPC Office of a personal-data breach within 72 hours of becoming aware of it, where feasible, as PDPA s.37(4) requires.
source_trace_up: RTR OPS-04; PDPA s.37(4) [V, unofficial translation, via RTR]; LINE Developers Agreement §5.2.2 (report unauthorised access) [V, via RTR]
acceptance_criterion: The procedure exists before G6 and names an owner and a backup; a tabletop drill before G6 reaches the "notify" step within the 72-hour clock on paper

title: Push counter and 80% alert
statement: The system shall count push messages sent per month and per tester, and shall alert the team when 80% of the plan's monthly allowance is used.
cp_plan_line: M1: deploy, secrets, logs, alerts, two channels (6–8 h)
source_trace_up: CP §7.5, E5, TD5; CON-BUD-02; IF-LINE-02; QR-PE-03 (merged)
acceptance_criterion: Test with the threshold lowered: the alert fires at the 80% mark. During P5, the counter agrees within 2% with LINE's "number of messages sent this month" endpoint [V endpoint exists, via RTR §1.3.5]

title: Monthly cost report
statement: The team shall produce a monthly cost report for the LLM API, hosting and the LINE plan, compared with the CON-BUD-01 cap.
source_trace_up: CON-BUD-01; AI-COST-02; charter §10; demoted M → S by judge D-01, Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: One report per month from P1 to P8, each with actuals, forecast and the cap

title: One switch pauses outbound messages
statement: The team shall be able to pause all outbound pushes and handoffs with one configuration switch, without deploying code.
source_trace_up: charter §11 "provide a stop/disable route"; demoted M → S by judge D-01. Must fallback without code: stop the worker process or disable the channel webhook in the LINE console, Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Drill before G6: switch on → a scheduled reminder is held, not sent; switch off → it is sent once (no duplicate)

title: Proposal package by 22 Nov 2026
statement: By 22 November 2026, the team shall submit a proposal package containing the problem, scope and exclusions, SRS v0.9 (every Must requirement with an acceptance criterion), architecture diagram, data model, threat model, risk list, test plan, traceability skeleton and plan.
acceptance_criterion: Checklist against charter §11 and the course rubric (OI-19): every item present in the submitted package

title: Final package by 30 Apr 2027
statement: By 30 April 2027, the team shall deliver the final package: SRS v1.0 (baselined), design document, test and evaluation report (with AI results per action), user guide in Thai, README for running the system, demo video, final report and handover record.
cp_plan_line: M7: report, demo, handover (design docs kept current) (12–16 h)
acceptance_criterion: Checklist at G8: every item present and reviewed by another member

title: Decision records for architecture choices
statement: Each of decisions D01–D10, and each later change that alters a component or interface in CP §7.1, shall be recorded as a short decision record (ADR: context, decision, consequences).
source_trace_up: RTR DOC-03; charter §9 decision log; trimmed by judge D-01, Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Inspection at each gate: each decision D01–D10 and each later material change has an ADR file

title: Test plan approved at G2
statement: A test plan giving test levels, environments, entry and exit criteria, and the Thai evaluation-set size and policy shall be approved at G2.
acceptance_criterion: G2 record lists the test plan as approved

title: Thai user guide before G6
statement: A one-page user guide for testers in Thai, part of the consent pack, covering what the assistant can and cannot do, the status words, Withdraw, help and data rights, shall be ready before G6 (28 Feb 2027; review Fri 26 Feb); an English version is optional.
cp_plan_line: M6: ethics and consent incl. businesses (3–5 h)
source_trace_up: RTR DOC-02 (user guide); UX-02; OPS-03; trimmed by judge D-01 (inside the CP M6 consent line), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Guide exists before G6 and is reviewed by a member who did not write it

title: Final report with Abdul comparison, limits
statement: The final report shall include the Abdul comparison (E13), the evaluation results with their intervals and outcome labels, and a statement that the sample does not represent all Bangkok working adults.
cp_plan_line: M7: report, demo, handover (design docs kept current) (12–16 h)
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the final report against these three items

title: Design document updated each gate
statement: The design document shall be updated at every gate from G3 to G8 so that it matches the built system.
cp_plan_line: M7: report, demo, handover (design docs kept current) (12–16 h)
source_trace_up: CP M7 "design docs kept current"; charter DoD; judge D-09 (CP M7 is Must)
acceptance_criterion: Each gate record links a design-document version dated within that phase

title: Acceptance criteria and test links on time
statement: Every Must requirement shall have an acceptance criterion before the proposal is submitted, and a linked test or evaluation case before the Phase 1 gate (G3 "foundations accepted", the gate that ends P1: target Sunday 13 Dec 2026, review Friday 11 Dec 2026; charter §8; decision D7); every Should requirement shall have a linked test before the prototype review (G5).
acceptance_criterion: Trace-table filter (§5): 0 Must rows with an empty acceptance criterion at submission; 0 Must rows with an empty "Verified by" at G3; 0 Should rows at G5

title: Report AI numbers from held-out set
statement: The AI evaluation set shall be split into a development part and a held-out part, and reported AI numbers shall come from the held-out part only.
cp_plan_line: M3: harness with held-out split (1–2 h)
acceptance_criterion: The harness stores the split with a version and a hash; the report cites only held-out results

title: Pilot quality-in-use measures, 15+ users
statement: The pilot shall measure task success, time to complete, number of corrections and user satisfaction, with at least 15 participants.
acceptance_criterion: G7 report contains the four measures from ≥ 15 participants, or states the actual number and the reason if fewer

title: Freeze thresholds before results
statement: All evaluation thresholds and decision rules in §4.4 shall be frozen with the design at G2 (20 Nov 2026) and shall not be changed after any result is seen.
source_trace_up: CP §9 opening; charter §8 "do not select them after seeing results"
acceptance_criterion: The G2 record holds a hash or dated copy of §4.4; the G7 report uses the same thresholds, or lists any change with a date before the first result

title: Intervals and labels on every result
statement: Every rate in the evaluation report shall be given with a 95% Wilson interval, every mean or median with a 95% interval, and every result that has a threshold with one of the outcome labels in §4.4.
acceptance_criterion: Inspection of the G7 report: every rate, mean and median has an interval; every result with a threshold has a label; descriptive results have none

title: Fault-injection suite before G6
statement: The fault-injection suite in §4.2 shall be run and passed before G6 and after every change to the ingress, worker or notifier.
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
acceptance_criterion: CI or test log: 0 duplicate tasks, reminders or cards over ≥ 100 replayed events; ≥ 99% of 1,000 scheduled test jobs attempt delivery within 60 seconds (E5)

title: Contract tests for LINE and LLM APIs
statement: Contract tests with recorded responses shall cover each LINE Messaging API call and LLM API call the system makes, with one recorded success and one recorded error response per call.
cp_plan_line: M5: isolation and fault injection (8–10 h)
source_trace_up: RTR §1.3.5 "Verify"; DEP-01, DEP-03; trimmed by judge D-01 (inside the CP M5 fault-injection line), Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: Each external call in the code has at least one success and one error contract test; all pass in CI. Timeout cases are covered by the fault-injection suite (VER-06)

title: Comparative black-box study of Abdul
statement: The team shall run a comparative black-box study of Abdul and our prototype by hand, under CON-ACAD-02, using the same subset of 8 task inputs on both (§4.5), within the 1–2 h CP M6 line "Abdul table".
source_trace_up: CP E13, M6; black-box script; TEAM-BRIEF boundary; trimmed by judge D-01, Appendix H
acceptance_criterion: A one-page summary (§4.5) with per-task results for both systems, filed in docs/research/abdul-recon/ with no personal data

title: Merge only with tests and review
statement: A change shall be merged to the main branch only when all unit and contract tests pass and another member has reviewed it.
acceptance_criterion: Repository settings or merge log show required checks and one review on every merge

title: Re-run E3, E4, E6 after P5 fixes
statement: After each defect fix during P5, the automated E3, E4 and E6 checks shall be re-run before the fix is deployed to the pilot channel.
acceptance_criterion: Deployment log: each P5 pilot deployment has a passing E3, E4, E6 run with the same commit

title: Start using the assistant
statement: Start using the assistant. Primary actor: Tester. Secondary: LINE Platform. Postconditions: Success: a user record exists with notice version, acceptance time and age statement. Failure: no message content from this user is stored or sent to the LLM
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Capture and confirm an obligation
statement: Capture and confirm an obligation. Primary actor: Tester. Secondary: LLM provider. Postconditions: Success: task Confirmed then Scheduled; obligation and its reminder job saved in one transaction; audit record (SEC-03). Cancel: task Discarded, no job
cp_plan_line: M2: capture, card, in-chat edit, cancel (5–7 h)
source_trace_up: STK-01, STK-02; SEED-FR-01; AI-HAL-01, AI-HAL-02, AI-HITL-01; CP §8.1
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Receive and act on a reminder
statement: Receive and act on a reminder. Primary actor: Job worker (time trigger). Secondary: Tester, LINE Platform. Postconditions: Push accepted by LINE and the occurrence marked sent; or deferred; or paused
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Complete a task with evidence
statement: Complete a task with evidence. Primary actor: Tester. Postconditions: Done, user-reported; or Done, evidence attached. Pending reminder jobs for the task cancelled
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Compose and confirm a request card
statement: Compose and confirm a request card. Primary actor: Tester. Secondary: LLM provider. Postconditions: Success: card version approved; approval record bound to its content hash; UC-07 starts. Cancel: Discarded
source_trace_up: STK-02, STK-05; SEED-FR-03; FR-ACT-01, AI-HITL-01, AI-EXP-01; CP §8.2–8.3
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Hand off request and record sending
statement: Hand off the request and record sending. Primary actor: Tester. Secondary: Business, LINE Platform. Postconditions: Request sent (with a follow-up job and a 10-minute Withdraw window), or Discarded, or Expired. Never "sent" without the user's Yes (or, S0, a POST answer)
cp_plan_line: M4: handoff and copy adapters with "Did you send it?" (3–4 h)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Follow up and record business answer
statement: Follow up and record the business's answer. Primary actor: Job worker. Secondary: Tester. Postconditions: User-confirmed then Scheduled (with an outcome reminder) or Closed; or Expired
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Withdraw a request
statement: Withdraw a request. Primary actor: Tester. Postconditions: Withdrawn; pending jobs cancelled; what could not be undone recorded
cp_plan_line: M4: follow-up, expiry, Withdraw jobs (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites

title: Export or delete my data
statement: Export or delete my data. Primary actor: Tester. Secondary: Project team. Postconditions: A data-rights request record exists with a due date 30 days later; the team runs the script by then
cp_plan_line: M5: privacy, retention, delete script (4–6 h)
acceptance_criterion: Scenario test walks the main flow and every alternative listed (§2.7.3), plus the FR tests it cites
